医疗保健系统规模虚拟患者表示的多模态和时间基础模型A multimodal and temporal foundation model for virtual patient representations at healthcare system scale

摘要Abstract

现代医学在孤立的系统中生成大量的多模式数据，但现有的模型没有将临床记录的全部广度和时间深度集成到统一的患者表示中。在本研究中，我们描述了模拟人类临床轨迹的综合努力。我们介绍 APOLLO，这是一种多模态时态基础模型，基于美国主要医院系统三十多年的纵向医院记录进行训练和评估，该模型由来自 720 万名患者的 250 亿条记录组成，代表 28 种不同的医疗模式和 12 个主要医学专业。 APOLLO 学习了一个统一的表示空间，该空间集成了我们临床词汇中超过 10 万个独特的医疗事件以及图像和临床文本。这个“医学概念图集”形成了一个计算基础，用于对由结构化和非结构化事件序列组成的整个患者护理旅程进行建模，这些事件被 APOLLO 压缩为虚拟患者表示。为了评估这些整体患者表征的潜力，我们从 140 万患者的保留测试集中创建了 322 个检索和预后任务。我们展示了 APOLLO 嵌入的广义临床预测潜力，包括提前五年预测新疾病发病风险（95 项任务）、疾病进展（78 项任务）、治疗反应（59 项任务）、治疗相关不良事件的风险（17 项任务）和医院运营终点（12 项任务）。使用 APOLLO 嵌入的线性探测在所有任务类别中都表现出强大的性能。在 30 项癌症进展基准上，APOLLO 甚至超越了特定任务的完全监督 Transformer 模型。使用特征归因技术，我们证明模型预测与临床可解释的多模式生物标志物一致。我们评估了 61 个检索任务的语义相似性搜索，并展示了 APOLLO 作为使用文本和图像查询的多模态医学搜索引擎的潜力。这些建模功能共同为可计算医学奠定了基础，使计算推理能够获取患者护理的完整背景。Modern medicine generates vast multimodal data across siloed systems, yet no existing model integrates the full breadth and temporal depth of the clinical record into a unified patient representation. In the present study, we describe a comprehensive effort to model human clinical trajectories. We introduce APOLLO, a multimodal temporal foundation model trained and evaluated on over three decades of longitudinal hospital records from a major US hospital system, composed of 25 billion records from 7.2 million patients, representing 28 distinct medical modalities and 12 major medical specialties. APOLLO learns a unified representation space integrating over 100 thousand unique medical events in our clinical vocabulary as well as images and clinical text. This “atlas of medical concepts” forms a computational substrate for modeling entire patient care journeys comprised of sequences of structured and unstructured events, which are compressed by APOLLO into virtual patient representations. To assess the potential of these whole-patient representations, we created 322 retrieval and prognosis tasks from a held-out test set of 1.4 million patients. We demonstrate the generalized clinical forecasting potential of APOLLO embeddings, including predicting new disease onset risk up to five years in advance (95 tasks), disease progression (78 tasks), treatment response (59 tasks), risk of treatment-related adverse events (17 tasks), and hospital operations endpoints (12 tasks). Linear probing with APOLLO embeddings exhibits strong performance across all task categories. On a 30-task cancer progression benchmark, APOLLO surpasses even task-specific fully-supervised transformer models. Using feature attribution techniques, we show that model predictions align with clinically-interpretable multimodal biomarkers. We evaluate semantic similarity search on 61 retrieval tasks, and moreover demonstrate the potential of APOLLO as a multimodal medical search engine using text and image queries. Together, these modeling capabilities establish the foundation for computable medicine, where the full context of patient care becomes accessible to computational reasoning.

简介Introduction

电子健康记录 (EHR) 作为现代医学的记录系统，通过系统地捕获复杂的纵向健康轨迹，支撑紧密耦合的护理、操作和研究领域。这些丰富的存储库为精准医疗和创建统一的、持续学习的医疗保健系统带来了巨大的希望 [1, 2]。然而，医疗保健面临着一个悖论：虽然每年生成 50 PB 的全球数据量的近 30%，但只有不到 3% 的数据被有效地用于临床洞察 [3, 4]。分散的护理造成的破坏性影响凸显了缩小这一差距的必要性，仅在美国每年就导致估计 795,000 例与诊断错误相关的死亡或永久性残疾 [5]。目前，释放电子病历的全部潜力不仅受到特定模式孤岛的系统碎片化的阻碍，而且还受到固有数据复杂性——极端维度、不规则性和稀疏性的阻碍[6,7]。Electronic Health Records (EHRs) function as the system of record for modern medicine, underpinning the tightly coupled domains of care, operations, and research by systematically capturing complex, longitudinal health trajectories. These rich repositories hold immense promise for precision medicine and the creation of a unified, continuously learning healthcare system [1, 2]. Yet, healthcare faces a paradox: while generating nearly 30% of global data volume at 50 petabytes annually, less than 3% is effectively utilized for clinical insight [3, 4]. The imperative to close this gap is underscored by the devastating impact of fragmented care, which contributes to an estimated 795,000 diagnostic error-related deaths or permanent disabilities annually in the United States alone [5]. Unlocking the full potential of EHRs is currently hindered not only by systemic fragmentation across modality-specific silos, but also inherent data complexities – extreme dimensionality, irregularity, and sparsity [6,7].

近年来，基础模型已经成为自然语言处理 [8, 9]、计算机视觉 [10, 11] 和计算生物学 [12, 13] 等领域的范式转变，通过大规模自我监督学习上下文丰富的表示，并有效地转移到不同的下游任务 [14]。尽管它们在医疗保健方面的潜力已得到认可[15,16]，但现有模型的范围仍然有限。大多数方法都是孤立地分析个体数据模式（例如病理图像或临床文本），这本质上限制了它们在需要全面了解患者的任务中的实用性[17-24]。由于易于利用现有本体（例如 ICD-10、SNOMED、LOINC）、数据仓库基础设施以及受大型语言模型 (LLM) 启发的离散令牌序列建模技术，构建纵向 EHR 基础模型 [25-35] 的工作在很大程度上仅限于结构化数据（例如诊断代码或实验室结果）[36]。然而，结构化数据只能提供患者的有限快照；诸如医学推理痕迹、疾病进展和新颖的生物标志物等微妙的细微差别通常只能在自由文本注释和成像中获得。最近的证据表明，多模态 AI 系统在诊断任务中的性能比单模态方法高出 6-33% [37, 38]，因此迫切需要能够合成全谱患者数据的统一模型。这一挑战反映了最近在创建虚拟细胞方面的努力，其中集成多模态数据的基础模型——例如，合成转录组、蛋白质组和形态学信号来预测细胞反应[39, 40]——已经证明了统一的表示如何能够捕获单模态方法错过的复杂系统动态。正如这些模型揭示了细胞状态转换中的新兴特性一样，虚拟患者也可以通过合成全谱纵向 EHR 数据来解锁对健康轨迹的类似见解。In recent years, foundation models have emerged as a paradigm shift across domains such as natural language processing [8, 9], computer vision [10, 11] and computational biology [12, 13], learning context-rich representations via large-scale self-supervision that transfer effectively to diverse downstream tasks [14]. While their potential in healthcare is recognized [15,16], existing models remain limited in scope. Most approaches analyze individual data modalities in isolation – such as pathology images or clinical text – which inherently limits their utility for tasks requiring a holistic view of the patient [17–24]. Efforts to build longitudinal EHR foundation models [25–35] have largely been restricted to structured data (e.g., diagnostic codes or laboratory results) [36] due to the ease of leveraging existing ontologies (e.g., ICD-10, SNOMED, LOINC), data warehousing infrastructure, and discrete-token sequence modeling techniques inspired by large language models (LLMs). However, structured data provides only a limited snapshot of a patient; subtle nuances such as medical reasoning traces, disease progression, and novel biomarkers are often only available in free-text notes and imaging. With recent evidence suggesting that multimodal AI systems can outperform single-modality approaches by 6–33% across diagnostic tasks [37, 38], there is a critical need for unified models capable of synthesizing the full spectrum of patient data. This challenge mirrors recent efforts in creating virtual cells, where foundation models that integrate multimodal data – for example, synthesizing transcriptomic, proteomic, and morphological signals to predict cellular responses [39, 40] – have demonstrated how unified representations can capture complex system dynamics that single-modality approaches miss. Just as these models revealed emergent properties in cellular state transitions, virtual patients could unlock similar insights into health trajectories by synthesizing the full spectrum of longitudinal EHR data.

为了实现这一愿景，我们引入了 APOLLO，这是一种多模式时间基础模型，可将整个纵向医疗记录转换为统一的计算表示。 APOLLO 首先使用特定于模态的编码器对单个医疗事件进行标记，然后使用变压器架构跨时间点融合生成的嵌入（请参阅To realize this vision, we introduce APOLLO, a multimodal temporal foundation model that transforms the entirety of the longitudinal medical record into a unified computational representation. APOLLO first tokenizes individual medical events using modality-specific encoders and then fuses the resulting embeddings across timepoints using a transformer architecture (see结果Results和and方法Methods了解完整的架构细节）。我们开发的 APOLLO 包含跨机构医疗保健系统 33 年来来自 720 万名患者的超过 250 亿个医疗事件，涵盖基于文本、结构化和成像模式。与仅限于单个部门或重症监护队列的精选研究数据集不同[41]，我们的语料库捕获了for full architectural details). We develop APOLLO with over 25 billion medical events from 7.2 million patients spanning 33 years across a multi-institutional healthcare system, encompassing text-based, structured, and imaging modalities. Unlike curated research datasets limited to single departments or critical care cohorts [41], our corpus captures the

2

17 个机构和附属诊所提供完整的住院和门诊护理服务，反映了现实世界中实践和人群的异质性。我们评估了 322 个旨在评估临床广度的下游任务，包括患者检索（61 个队列）、预测新疾病发作（95 个任务）、疾病进展（78 个任务）、治疗反应（59 个任务）、药物不良事件（17 个任务）和医院运营终点（12 个任务）。整个患者的嵌入在预后任务上实现了出色的性能，能够从大型数据库中进行多模态引导检索，产生反映表型簇的可解释的潜在结构，并揭示多模态生物标志物。总之，这些结果表明，统一的、基于时间的患者表示可以将 EHR 从静态档案转换为用于护理、研究和操作的主动计算基础，这是下一代可计算医学的基础。full continuum of inpatient and outpatient care across 17 institutions and affiliated clinics, reflecting real-world heterogeneity in both practice and population. We evaluate APOLLO across 322 downstream tasks designed to assess clinical breadth, including patient retrieval (61 cohorts), predicting new disease onset (95 tasks), disease progression (78 tasks), treatment response (59 tasks), drug adverse events (17 tasks), and hospital operations endpoints (12 tasks). The whole-patient embeddings achieve strong performance on prognostic tasks, enable multimodal guided retrieval from a large-scale database, yield interpretable latent structures that mirror phenotypic clusters, and reveal multimodal biomarkers. Together, these results demonstrate that unified, temporally grounded patient representations can convert the EHR from a static archive into an active computational substrate for care, research, and operations – the foundation for next-generation computable medicine.

结果Results

建立临床时间序列数据的基础模型Building a foundation model for clinical time series data

APOLLO 是一种基于 Transformer 的模型，它将整个纵向、多模式医疗记录（包括临床报告、结构化数据和成像数据）集成到时间环境中。我们整理了 MGB-7M，其中包含 7,155,044 份患者电子健康记录 (EHR)，其中包含 25,296,943,893 个不同的医疗事件。 MGB-7M 来自多机构医疗保健组织，包括专科医院、门诊医院和教学医院（APOLLO is a transformer-based model that integrates the entirety of a longitudinal, multimodal medical record, including clinical reports, structured data, and imaging data, in a temporal context. We curated MGB-7M, consisting of 7,155,044 patient electronic health records (EHR) with 25,296,943,893 distinct medical events. MGB-7M comes from a multi-institutional healthcare organization including specialty, ambulatory, and teaching hospitals (图1aFigure 1a）。这些事件跨越33年，其中大部分事件发生在过去15年。该数据集在男性 (3,915,625) 和女性 (3,236,747) 患者之间大致平衡，大多数患者在上次医疗记录时年龄在 18 至 79 岁之间（). The events span 33 years of which the majority of events are in the past 15 years. The dataset is roughly balanced between male (3,915,625) and female (3,236,747) patients, with the majority of patients between 18 and 79 years old at the time of their last medical record (扩展数据表1Extended Data Table 1）。 MGB-7M 涵盖整个诊断范围，包括流程图测量（22,936,351,260 个事件）、实验室测试（1,442,631,333 个事件）、生命体征（505,193,723 个事件）以及基于文本的观察，包括进度说明（158,683,290 个注释）和来自各个医学领域的诊断报告（77,978,881 个报告）和成像数据（1,158,235 张图像）包括血液学和组织病理学成像（). MGB-7M covers the entire diagnostic spectrum including flowsheet measurements (22,936,351,260 events), laboratory tests (1,442,631,333 events), vital signs (505,193,723 events), and text-based observations including progress notes (158,683,290 notes) and diagnostic reports from various medical domains (77,978,881 reports), and imaging data (1,158,235 images) including hematology and histopathology imaging (图1b-e，扩展数据表2Figure 1b-e, Extended Data Table 2）。 MGB-7M 涵盖多种临床实体，具有来自 12 个主要医学领域的诊断报告（). MGB-7M covers a diverse spectrum of clinical entities with diagnostic reports from 12 major medical domains (扩展数据表2Extended Data Table 2），药物涵盖解剖治疗化学 (ATC) 分类的所有 14 章 (), medications covering all 14 chapters of the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification (扩展数据表3Extended Data Table 3），疾病代码涵盖国际疾病分类（ICD）本体的所有章节 [42]，平均每章有 180 万个诊断（), and disease codes spanning all chapters of the International Classification of Diseases (ICD) ontology [42], with on average 1.8 million diagnoses per chapter (扩展数据表4Extended Data Table 4 ).

APOLLO 将患者历史中的所有医疗事件整合为统一的、时间感知的数学表示形式。受大型语言模型的启发，我们将医疗记录转换为令牌序列：结构化数据映射到离散事件令牌序列，而非结构化数据模态被读取为文本令牌或图像补丁令牌。每种模式（文本、图像或结构化）都使用特定模式的适配器独立转换为连续嵌入（价值标记）。更具体地说，我们使用临床大语言模型[18]对基于文本的模态进行编码，使用医学视觉基础模型[43,44]对图像进行编码，并将结构化标记映射到可学习的嵌入（APOLLO integrates all medical events in the patient history into a unified, temporally aware mathematical representation. Inspired by large language models, we convert the medical record into a sequence of tokens: structured data are mapped to sequences of discrete event tokens, while unstructured data modalities are read as text tokens or image patch tokens. Each modality – text, imaging, or structured – is independently converted into continuous embeddings (value tokens) using modality-specific adapters. More specifically, we encode text-based modalities using a clinical large language model [18], we encode images using medical vision foundation models [43,44], and we map structured tokens to learnable embeddings (图1f)Figure 1f)。随后，所有标记都通过特定于模态的层投影到反映语义的公共表示空间。. 图1：Figure 1:MGB-7M 和 APOLLO 概述。Overview of MGB-7M and APOLLO.(a) 预训练数据集 MGB-7M 概述，该数据集来自一个包含 715 万名患者的大型医疗保健系统中的 17 家医院。 (b-e) MGB-7M 的详细分布，包括 (b) 测量的 LOINC 代码分布，(c) 跨医学领域的诊断报告分布，(d) 按 ATC 分类分组的药物，以及 (e) 按 ICD10 章节分组的 ICD10 代码。 (f) 成像数据、基于文本的临床记录和诊断报告以及实验室测试、药物和诊断等结构化测量的特定模态编码。 (g) APOLLO 的模型架构，一种编码器-解码器架构，以患者人口统计数据（年龄、性别、种族）和时间上下文中所有患者记录的嵌入作为输入。预训练的目标是屏蔽建模，其中重建特定于模态的屏蔽标记。 (h) 在推理时，所有患者记录与一个额外的标记一起输入模型，该标记在最后一个时间步产生患者嵌入。 (i) 用于疾病发作、疾病进展和治疗结果风险预测的事件发生时间任务的管理示意图。 (j) 从大型候选患者数据库（灰色）中检索查询患者嵌入（蓝色）的患者示意图。(a) Overview of the pretraining dataset MGB-7M curated from 17 hospitals in one large-scale health care system consisting of 7.15 million patients. (b-e) Detailed distribution of MGB-7M including (b) LOINC code distribution of measurements, (c) distribution of diagnostic reports across medical domains, (d) medications grouped by ATC classification, and (e) ICD10 codes grouped by ICD10 chapters. (f) Modality-specific encodings of imaging data, text-based clinical notes and diagnostic reports, and structured measurements such as laboratory tests, medications, and diagnosis. (g) Model architecture of APOLLO, an encoder-decoder architecture taking patient demographics (age, sex, ethnicity) and embeddings of all patient records in a temporal context as input. The pretraining objective is masked modeling, where modality-specific masked tokens are reconstructed. (h) At inference, all patient records are fed into the model together with one additional token that yields the patient embedding at the last time step. (i) Schematic of the curation of time-to-event tasks for risk prediction of disease onset, disease progression, and treatment outcome. (j) Schematic for patient retrieval for a query patient embedding (blue) from a large-scale database of candidate patients (gray).

事件之间的抽动关系。我们将患者人口统计数据（上次事件的年龄、性别和种族）添加到输入序列中，并将每个时间步的患者年龄作为位置（时间）编码添加到每个事件中（tic relationships between events. We prepend patient demographics (age at last event, sex, and ethnicity) to the input sequence and add the per-timestep patient age to each event as a positional (time) encoding (图1gFigure 1g）。通过将主要计算单元（时间转换器）与原始数据隔离，我们降低了受保护的健康信息（PHI）泄漏的风险，因为没有原始数据进入最终模型。 APOLLO 有效地将培训从跨所有部门、卫星诊所的活跃多机构 EHR 系统扩展到 28 种模式，涵盖住院和门诊。这与现有的 EHR 建模工作形成对比 [31,32,45]). By isolating the main computational unit (the temporal transformer) from the raw data, we reduce the risk of protected health information (PHI) leakage since no raw data enters the final model. APOLLO effectively scales training to 28 modalities from an active multi-institutional EHR system across all departments, satellite clinics, covering both inpatient and outpatient visits. This is in contrast to existing EHR modeling efforts [31,32,45]

4

利用经过大量管理和预处理的精选、可公开访问的数据集，仅限于特定的临床部门，如 MIMIC-IV [41]，或仅限于结构化数据模式 [46]。我们使用带有特定模态掩码的掩码令牌建模 [9] 来预训练 APOLLO，这些掩码会在前向传递过程中提示输出头采用正确的模态（更多详细信息，请参阅第 1 节）utilizing curated, publicly accessible datasets which have undergone substantial curation and preprocessing, are restricted to specific clinical departments such as MIMIC-IV [41], or are limited to structured data modalities only [46]. We pretrain APOLLO employing masked token modeling [9] with modality-specific masks that prompt the output head for the correct modality during the forward pass (for more details see Section预训练Pretraining in 在线方法Online Methods , 扩展数据表5Extended Data Table 5）。为了在推理过程中生成患者嵌入，最后（最近）的时间标记将与特定于模态的掩码标记一起作为提示附加到输入序列，并且相应的隐藏状态用作患者嵌入（). To generate a patient embedding during inference, the last (most recent) time token is appended to the input sequence along with a modality-specific mask token as prompt, and the corresponding hidden state is used as the patient embedding (图1hFigure 1h）。在实践中，任何模态掩码都可以用作提示，并且最终的患者嵌入会针对该模态进行调整。例如，我们随后探讨了文本和图像提示的患者嵌入在多模态语义检索中的应用。然而，对于大多数下游任务，由于大多数任务都是以疾病为导向的，我们使用诊断掩码作为提示。). In practice, any modality mask can be used as the prompt, and the resulting patient embedding is tuned towards that modality. For example, we later explore the applications of text- and image-prompted patient embeddings in multimodal semantic retrieval. For the majority of downstream tasks, however, we utilize the diagnosis mask as the prompt, due to the disease-oriented nature of most tasks.

我们在 261 个预后任务和 61 个检索任务上对 APOLLO 进行了评估，旨在证明这些患者级嵌入的通用用途。为了评估预后价值，我们使用冻结的 APOLLO 患者嵌入作为特征来训练 Cox 比例风险模型以进行事件发生时间 (TTE) 预测（We evaluate APOLLO on a wide set of 261 prognostic and 61 retrieval tasks designed to demonstrate the general-purpose utility of these patient-level embeddings. To assess prognostic value, we train Cox proportional hazards models for time-to-event (TTE) prediction using the frozen APOLLO patient embedding as features (图1iFigure 1i）。临床终点包括新发疾病、疾病进展、治疗反应终点、药物相关不良事件和急性医院运营终点。除了预后之外，APOLLO 患者嵌入还可用作检索具有相似病史和医学表型的患者的搜索索引。最后，我们深入了解驱动模型风险预测的临床因素，标志着跨整个医疗记录的生物医学发现迈出了一步（). Clinical endpoints include new disease onset, disease progression, treatment response endpoints, drug-related adverse events, and acute hospital operations endpoints. Beyond prognosis, APOLLO patient embeddings can be used as a search index for retrieving patients with similar disease history and medical phenotypes. Lastly, we extract insights into the clinical factors driving model risk predictions, marking a step towards biomedical discovery across the entirety of the medical record (图1jFigure 1j ).

APOLLO 的嵌入空间作为医学概念图集APOLLO’s embedding space as an atlas of medical concepts

APOLLO 首次将整个医疗记录中的孤立事件纳入统一的嵌入空间，从而可以对模内和跨模态关系进行详细研究。为了了解 APOLLO 如何统一跨模态的数据表示，我们在 MGB-7M 上进行预训练后检查 APOLLO 的输入嵌入空间。结构化模式，即流程图、生命体征、实验室测试、药物和诊断代码，概括了整个医疗事件，并通过类比语言模型，形成了用于组成患者时间表的 APOLLO 词汇表。记录中出现超过 100 次的所有 103,940 个离散标记的低维表示表明，APOLLO 通过将流程图、生命体征和实验室测试分组为不同的语义集群（例如过敏、凝血、药物和毒理学或血液学）来捕获类似的医学概念，并与 LOINC 本体中的父类别保持一致（For the first time, APOLLO brings siloed events across the entirety of the medical record into a unified embedding space, permitting the detailed study of intra- and cross-modal relationships. To understand how APOLLO unifies data representations across modalities, we examine the input embedding space of APOLLO after pretraining on MGB-7M. The structured modalities, i.e., flowsheets, vitals, laboratory tests, medications, and diagnosis codes, generalize across medical events and, by analogy to language modeling, form APOLLO’s vocabulary used to compose patient timelines. The low-dimensional representations of all 103,940 discrete tokens that occurred more than 100 times in the records show that APOLLO captures similar medical concepts by grouping flowsheets, vitals, and lab tests into distinct semantic clusters, such as allergy, coagulation, drug & toxicology, or hematology, aligning with parent categories in the LOINC ontology (图2aFigure 2a ).

在预训练期间使用特定于模态的掩模，APOLLO 可以学习模态之间的自然分离，例如诊断代码和药物。通过仔细检查诊断标记，我们发现相关疾病的疾病标记紧密嵌入（Using modality-specific masks during pretraining, APOLLO learns a natural separation between modalities, such as diagnostic codes and medications. Upon closer examination of the diagnostic tokens, we observe that the disease tokens of related diseases are closely embedded (图2bFigure 2b）。在 ICD10 章节中，眼部疾病与其他章节中与眼睛相关的疾病聚集在一起，例如眼睛和附件的良性肿瘤。在循环系统疾病中，后天性和先天性心脏相关疾病都与急性心肌梗塞相邻。同样，不同的淋巴瘤紧密地聚集在一起。这些结果表明，APOLLO 学习了基础条件和条件之间的多尺度语义关系。). Across the ICD10 chapters, diseases of the eye cluster together with eye-related diseases from other chapters, such as benign neoplasms of eye and adnexa. Within diseases of the circulatory system, both acquired and congenital heart-related diseases are neighboring acute myocardial infarction. Similarly, different lymphomas cluster closely together. These results show that APOLLO learns multiscale semantic relationships between underlying conditions and

The emerging atlas of medical concepts exhibits meaningful spatial relationships both within modalities, as seen for (b) diagnosis codes and (c) for medications, as well as across modalities (d). 由 RxNorm 成分代码标记的处方药物和药物成分的嵌入显示出相似的语义聚类（The embeddings of prescribed medications and drug components labeled by RxNorm ingredient code show similar semantic clustering (图2cFigure 2c）。特别是，APOLLO 紧密嵌入了 pembrolizumab 和 nivolumab 等药物，这两种药物均用于针对癌细胞中 PD-1 蛋白的免疫疗法，以及抗逆转录病毒药物，如阿巴卡韦、拉米夫定或利匹韦林，这些药物联合使用治疗 HIV 感染。与 2 型糖尿病相关的药物，如格列吡嗪和二甲双胍，与血糖指标胰岛素和葡萄糖紧密结合在一起。). In particular, APOLLO closely embeds drugs such as pembrolizumab and nivolumab, both used in immunotherapies targeting the PD-1 protein in cancer cells, and antiretroviral drugs, such as abacavir, lamivudine, or rilpivirine, which are used in combination to treat HIV infections. Drugs related to type 2 diabetes, such as glipizide and metformin, are grouped together in close proximity to blood sugar indicators insulin and glucose.

除了编码结构化信息的离散令牌之外，APOLLO 还对特定于事件的诊断进行编码Beyond discrete tokens encoding structured information, APOLLO additionally encodes event-specific diag-

6

历史报告、进展说明或临床图像。值得注意的是，这些非结构化事件嵌入映射到图集中对应于语义相关的结构化标记的位置。为了了解文本和图像如何与离散输入嵌入空间集成，我们分析了一名患者（30-40 岁，男性）一天医疗记录中的所有嵌入，包括 184 项实验室测试、58 项流程图条目、一种药物、六份临床报告、三份进展记录和一张血涂片的图像（nostic reports, progress notes, or clinical images. Remarkably, these unstructured event embeddings map to locations in the atlas which correspond to semantically related structured tokens. To understand how text and images integrate with the discrete input embedding space, we analyze all embeddings of one patient (30-40 y.o., male) in one day of their medical record, consisting of 184 lab tests, 58 flow sheet entries, one medication, six clinical reports, three progress notes, and images from one blood smear (图2dFigure 2d）。我们观察到，骨髓穿刺和骨髓活检的临床报告与细胞遗传学报告紧密相连，所有三个报告都位于绿色的血液学簇内。所有与血细胞计数相关的实验室测试都与血涂片图像位于同一血液学集群中。与血涂片最接近的实验室测试显示，中性粒细胞及其前体形式的后髓细胞水平升高，与活检记录和进展记录中提到的白细胞增多的观察结果一致。描述患者就诊的进度说明与常规流程图条目一起位于管理事件集群中。 APOLLO 以完全自我监督的方式学习各种医疗事件（结构化和非结构化）的临床医生一致表示，形成多模式医学图谱。这些嵌入是对患者状态表示进行建模的构建块。). We observe that the clinical reports from the bone marrow aspirate and bone marrow biopsy are embedded close to the cytogenetic report, all three situated within the hematology cluster in green. All blood count-related lab tests are located in the same hematology cluster as are the blood smear images. The closest lab tests to the blood smear show elevated levels of neutrophils and their precursor form metamyelocytes, in line with the observation of leukocytosis mentioned in the biopsy note and progress note. The progress note describing the patient visit is located in the administrative events cluster together with routine flowsheet entries. In a completely self-supervised manner, APOLLO learns clinician-aligned representations of diverse medical events, both structured and unstructured, forming a multimodal atlas of medicine. These embeddings are the building blocks for modeling representations of the patient state.

APOLLO 患者嵌入编码医学表型APOLLO patient embeddings encode medical phenotypes

通过时间感知变压器架构，APOLLO 编码的各个医疗事件被组成患者级表示，编码患者的整个临床病史。在 10 万名随机抽样患者的 UMAP 中，每个患者都在随机时间点，我们观察到他们的嵌入反映了潜在的疾病表型、年龄梯度和共同的病史（Through the time-aware transformer architecture, the individual medical events encoded by APOLLO are composed into patient-level representations which encode the entire clinical history of a patient. In a UMAP of 100 thousand randomly sampled patients, each at a random timepoint, we observe that their embeddings reflect underlying disease phenotypes, age gradients, and shared medical histories (图3aFigure 3a）。我们重点关注与乳腺癌、妊娠、血癌、皮肤病和代谢紊乱相关的集群。就像单个事件嵌入一样，这些集群是以自我监督的方式从头开始学习的。由于患者嵌入是动态的并随着时间的推移而变化，因此我们可以在患者接近疾病发作或经历疾病进展时追踪其轨迹。对于最终被诊断为精神分裂症的一组患者，当他们接近诊断日期时，他们的嵌入会汇聚到嵌入空间的同一区域（红星；). We highlight clusters related to breast cancer, pregnancy, blood cancers, skin disorders, and metabolic disorders. Just like the individual event embeddings, these clusters are learned from scratch in a self-supervised manner. Because patient embeddings are dynamic and change over time, we can trace their trajectories as patients approach the onset of a disease or experience disease progression. For a cohort of patients who are eventually diagnosed with schizophrenia, their embeddings converge to the same region of the embedding space as they approach the diagnosis date (red stars;图3bFigure 3b）。同样，在诊断出青光眼后的几个月内，一组患者的轨迹分为最终失明的一组和表现出不同且大多不相关的病症的一组。). Similarly, patient trajectories of a cohort in the months following a diagnosis of glaucoma diverge into a group eventually developing blindness and a group showing different mostly unrelated conditions (图3cFigure 3c ).

阿波罗预测新疾病发作的风险APOLLO predicts risk of new disease onset

我们评估了 APOLLO 在 95 个下游任务上对新疾病发作的预测能力。更具体地说，我们策划的终点包括 94 种不同的疾病代码，涵盖从心血管和循环系统疾病到癌症等八个类别，以及全因死亡率（We evaluate the predictive capabilities of APOLLO on 95 downstream tasks for new disease onset. More specifically, we curate endpoints including 94 distinct disease codes spanning eight categories ranging from cardiovascular and circulatory diseases to cancers, as well as all-cause mortality (图 3d，扩展数据表 6Figure 3d, Extended Data Table 6）。每项疾病发作任务总共至少包括 6 万名患者，其中每项任务未经审查的患者（经历终点的患者）数量在 157 至 27,503 人之间，反映了现实世界疾病发生率的高度可变。所有任务均从 MGB-7M 测试集中策划，涵盖总共 1,431,009 名患者，患者数量各不相同). Each disease onset task includes at least 60 thousand patients in total, where the number of uncensored patients (those who experience the endpoint) ranges from 157 to 27,503 per task reflecting highly variable real-world disease incidences. All tasks are curated from the test set of MGB-7M spanning 1,431,009 patients in total with a varying numbern根据纳入标准，每项任务考虑的患者数量。of patients considered per task depending on the inclusion criteria.

对于每种疾病，我们从随机出院开始预测诊断时间（以下称为For each disease, we predict time to diagnosis starting from a random hospital discharge (hereafter referred to as the快照时间snapshot time;看到; see评估框架Evaluation Framework in 在线方法Online Methods）对 PCA 转换的 APOLLO 患者嵌入使用 Cox 回归模型。作为主要性能指标，我们报告了根据疾病的生理时程，在未来一到六年之间的固定阈值持续时间内评估的时间依赖性累积/动态 AUC。作为统计参考，我们使用患者年龄和性别作为特征来训练单独的 Cox 模型。总体而言，APOLLO 在 95 种疾病中的 74 种疾病上显着优于基线（) using a Cox-regression model on PCA-transformed APOLLO patient embeddings. As the primary performance metric, we report time-dependent cumulative/dynamic AUC evaluated at a fixed threshold duration between one and six years in the future depending on the physiological time course of the disease. As a statistical reference, we train separate Cox models using patient age and sex as features. Overall, APOLLO significantly outperforms the baseline on 74 out of 95 diseases (p < 0 . 05).

根据疾病类别，APOLLO 在明年全因死亡率的风险预测方面表现最佳（0.92 AUROC）。通过研究表现最好的类别中的具体疾病，我们发现 APOLLO 显着改善了心血管和循环系统疾病的年龄-性别特征的风险预测：3 年心力衰竭预测从 0.77 AUROC 改善至 0.88 AUROC，1 年急性心肌梗死从 0.68 AUROC 改善至 0.82 AUROC，1 年颅内出血预测从 0.71 改善至 0.81 （全部Per disease category, APOLLO performs best on risk prediction of all-cause mortality within the next year (0.92 AUROC). Investigating the specific diseases in the best-performing categories, we find that APOLLO significantly improves risk prediction over age-sex features for cardiovascular and circulatory diseases: 3-year heart failure prediction improves from 0.77 to 0.88 AUROC, 1-year acute myocardial infarction improves from 0.68 to 0.82 AUROC, and 1-year intracranial hemorrhage improves from 0.71 to 0.81 (allp < 0 .0001）。对于与神经病学和精神病学相关的疾病，APOLLO 预测 1 年患精神分裂症的风险为 0.92 AUROC，而 0.65，双向情感障碍的预测为 0.86 AUROC，而 0.63，癫痫的 1 年风险为 0.86 AUROC，而 0.59（全部0001). For conditions related to neurology and psychiatry, APOLLO predicts 1-year risks for schizophrenia with 0.92 AUROC compared to 0.65, bipolar disorder with 0.86 AUROC compared to 0.63, and epilepsy with 0.86 AUROC compared to 0.59 (allp < 0 .0001）。对于内分泌和生殖系统疾病，APOLLO 将高催乳素血症的 3 年风险预测从 0.78 显着提高到 0.85（0001). For diseases of the endocrine and reproductive system, APOLLO significantly improves the 3-year risk prediction of hyperprolactinemia from 0.78 to 0.85 (p < 0 .01），2 型糖尿病的 3 年风险从 0.61 到 0.85（01), for 3-year risk of type 2 diabetes from 0.61 to 0.85 (p < 0 .0001），痛风的 1 年风险从 0.74 降至 0.83（0001), and for 1-year risk of gout from 0.74 to 0.83 (p < 0 .01）AUROC，分别（01) AUROC, respectively (图3dFigure 3d）。所有实验的结果可以在). APOLLO 患者表征预测疾病进展APOLLO patient representations predict disease progression

为了评估 APOLLO 在更有针对性的队列中预测疾病进展的性能，我们策划了 78 项任务来预测患者从某种疾病进展为更严重疾病的风险。我们的任务涵盖八种疾病类别，并且我们预测原始疾病诊断与进展疾病之间的时间（To assess the performance of APOLLO in predicting disease progression in more targeted cohorts, we curate 78 tasks for predicting the risk of a patient to progress from a disease to a more severe form. Our tasks span eight disease categories, and we predict time between diagnosis of the original disease and the progressed form (图 3e，扩展数据表 8Figure 3e, Extended Data Table 8）。由于筛选患者候选集的纳入标准更加严格，这些任务的发生率高于新开始任务（更多详细信息，请参见). The incidence for these tasks is higher than for the new onset tasks due to more restrictive inclusion criteria for the candidate set of censored patients (for more details see下游任务Downstream tasks in 在线方法Online Methods）。与新的起始任务制定类似，我们使用 Cox 回归模型对风险进行建模，该模型的任务绩效是在不同的阈值持续时间内计算的，从 60 天（对于急性疾病）到 5 年（对于更多慢性疾病）。总体而言，APOLLO 在 78 种疾病中的 53 种疾病的绝大多数任务中显着优于基线（). Similar to the new onset task formulation, we model the risk using a Cox-regression model with task performances computed over varying threshold durations, from 60 days (for acute diseases) up to five years (for more chronic diseases). Overall, APOLLO significantly outperforms the baseline on the large majority of tasks with 53 out of 78 diseases (p < 0 . 05).

APOLLO 在心血管和循环系统疾病进展的风险预测方面表现出最高的增益（平均从 0.65 AUROC 到 0.75 AUROC），其次是呼吸系统疾病和传染病进展（平均从 0.63 AUROC 到 0.75 AUROC）以及癌症进展（平均从 0.62 AUROC 到 0.74 AUROC）。更具体地说，APOLLO 可以预测高血压导致心力衰竭的 5 年风险显着优于基线（0.75 至 0.86），中风后 3 年生存率 AUROC 为 0.84，而基线为 0.72，主动脉瓣狭窄后 3 年生存率为 0.83，而基线为 0.72（全部APOLLO shows the highest gains in risk prediction for disease progression for cardiovascular and circulatory diseases (on average from 0.65 to 0.75 AUROC), followed by the progression of diseases of the respiratory system and infectious diseases (on average from 0.63 to 0.75 AUROC), and the progression of cancers (on average from 0.62 to 0.74 AUROC). More specifically, APOLLO can predict the 5-year risk of hypertension to heart failure significantly better than the baseline (0.75 to 0.86), 3-year survival after stroke with 0.84 AUROC compared to 0.72 from the baseline, and 3-year survival after aortic stenosis with 0.83 compared to 0.72 for the baseline (allp < 0 .0001）。此外，APOLLO 显着提高了 3 年内哮喘发作的风险预测（从 0.57 AUROC 提高到 0.83 AUROC，0001). Moreover, APOLLO significantly improves the risk prediction for asthma exacerbation within 3 years (from 0.57 to 0.83 AUROC,p < 0 .0001) 和慢性阻塞性肺病0001) and chronic obstructive pulmonary

3年内疾病（COPD）恶化（从0.57到0.79，disease (COPD) exacerbation within 3 years (from 0.57 to 0.79,p < 0 .001）。最后，黑色素瘤的生存预测从 0.71 显着提高到 0.87（3 年生存率），前列腺癌的生存预测从 0.74 提高到 0.84（5 年生存率）（两者均001). Finally, survival prediction significantly improves for melanoma from 0.71 to 0.87 (3-year survival) and for prostate cancer from 0.74 to 0.84 (5-year survival) (bothp < 0 .0001）。慢性粒细胞白血病的生存率也从 0.75 提高到 0.83（5 年生存率），但由于引导程序之间的方差相对较高，这种差异在统计上并不显着。所有实验的结果可以在0001). APOLLO 预测治疗反应和不良事件风险APOLLO predicts treatment response and risk of adverse events

为了评估 APOLLO 对药物反应的建模效果，我们策划了一组 59 项治疗反应预测任务，涵盖六种疾病类别，其中大多数治疗是肿瘤药物或免疫调节剂（To evaluate how well APOLLO can model response to medications, we curate a set of 59 tasks for treatment response prediction spanning six disease categories, where the majority of treatments are neoplastic or immunomodulating agents (图 3f，扩展数据表 10Figure 3f, Extended Data Table 10）。与之前的任务类似，我们使用 Cox 回归来预测从首次治疗给药时间开始的每个终点的风险。总体而言，APOLLO 在 59 项任务中的 30 项上显着优于基准（). Similar to the previous tasks, we use Cox regression to predict the risk for each endpoint starting from time of first treatment administration. Overall, APOLLO significantly outperforms the baseline on 30 out of 59 tasks (p < 0 . 05).

在疾病类别中，表现最好的组是作用于内分泌系统的药物，其中 APOLLO 将风险预测从 0.57 AUROC 提高到 0.8 AUROC，以及作用于心血管和循环系统的药物，其中使用 APOLLO 嵌入，性能从 0.64 AUROC 提高到 0.75 AUROC（Among the disease categories, the best performing groups are medications acting on the endocrine system, where APOLLO improves the risk prediction from 0.57 to 0.8 AUROC, and on the cardiovascular and circulatory system tract, where the performance increases from 0.64 to 0.75 AUROC using APOLLO embeddings (图 3f，扩展数据表 10Figure 3f, Extended Data Table 10）。特别是，APOLLO 预测阿哌沙班治疗心房颤动的无卒中生存期为 0.81 AUROC，显着优于基线 0.69（). In particular, APOLLO predicts stroke-free survival on apixaban therapy for atrial fibrillation with 0.81 AUROC significantly better than the baseline with 0.69 (p < 0 .0001），氯沙坦治疗高血压的无主要不良心脏事件（MACE）生存期为 0.8 AUROC（0001) and major adverse cardiac events (MACE)-free survival on losartan for hypertension with 0.8 AUROC (p < 0 .0001）和氨氯地平治疗高血压，AUROC 为 0.79（0001) and on amlodipine for hypertension with 0.79 AUROC (p < 0 .0001）。对于呼吸系统的治疗，APOLLO 预测噻托溴铵治疗 COPD 的生存率为 0.75 AUROC，而 AUROC 为 0.59（0001). For treatments of the respiratory system, APOLLO predicts the survival on tiotropium for COPD with 0.75 AUROC compared to 0.59 (p < 0 .001），使用 umeclidinium/vilanterol 治疗 COPD 的无恶化生存期为 0.71 AUROC，而 AUROC 为 0.6。最后，对于癌症治疗，APOLLO 显着提高了曲妥珠单抗和帕妥珠单抗（这两种针对 HER2 阳性乳腺癌的靶向疗法）的生存预测，从 0.66 提高到 0.93（001) and exacerbation-free survival on umeclidinium/vilanterol for COPD with 0.71 AUROC compared to 0.6. Finally, for cancer treatments, APOLLO significantly improves survival prediction on trastuzumab and pertuzumab, both targeted therapies for HER2-positive breast cancers, from 0.66 to 0.93 (p < 0 .0001) 和从 0.75 到 0.89 (0001) and from 0.75 to 0.89 (p < 0 .05）。同样，APOLLO 显着改善了乳腺癌紫杉醇化疗的生存预测（从 0.75 提高到 0.88，05). Similarly, APOLLO significantly improves survival prediction for chemotherapy with paclitaxel for breast cancer (from 0.75 to 0.88,p < 0 .01) 以及用于前列腺癌的亮丙瑞林激素治疗（从 0.65 到 0.86，01) and for hormone therapy with leuprolide for prostate cancer (from 0.65 to 0.86,p < 0 .0001）。所有实验的结果可以在0001). 为了评估 APOLLO 预测临床相关不良事件的能力，我们评估了一组精心策划的 17 项任务，涵盖心血管、胃肠道、代谢和药物引起的并发症（To assess the ability of APOLLO to anticipate clinically relevant adverse events, we evaluate a curated set of 17 tasks covering cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, metabolic, and drug-induced complications (图 3g，扩展数据表 12Figure 3g, Extended Data Table 12）。在所有不良事件任务中，APOLLO 在 17 项任务中的 12 项上显着改善了基线的风险分层。对于接触非甾体抗炎药 (NSAID) 后的不良事件，急性肾损伤的表现显着增加（AUROC 0.80 至 0.91，). Across all adverse-event tasks, APOLLO significantly improves risk stratification on 12 out of 17 tasks over the baseline. For adverse events after nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) exposure, performance increases significantly for acute kidney injury (AUROC 0.80 to 0.91,p < 0 .0001）和胃肠道出血（0.80 至 0.91，0001) and GI bleeding (0.80 to 0.91,p < 0 .01）。同样，该模型捕捉了代谢风险，在预测全身性皮质类固醇使用后治疗中出现的 2 型糖尿病方面取得了显着进展（0.70 至 0.87，01). Similarly, the model captures metabolic risk with significant gains in predicting treatment-emergent type 2 diabetes following systemic corticosteroid use (0.70 to 0.87,p < 0 .0001）和非典型抗精神病药物治疗（0.69至0.84，0001) and atypical antipsychotic therapy (0.69 to 0.84,p < 0 .0001）。所有实验的结果可以在0001). Results for all experiments can be found in扩展数据表13Extended Data Table 13 .

区分不同治疗方法的比较任务和不同治疗方法的预测任务是很重要的。It is important to distinguish between the task of comparing across treatments versus making predictions across

10

我们场景中的患者。由于每项任务都以特定的治疗为条件，因此这些预测在治疗组内而不是跨药物进行分层。因此，风险评分可能反映了患者基线健康状况和治疗特定因素的组合：例如，因 NSAID 不良事件风险较高的患者可能具有使他们容易发生一般不良事件的潜在条件，而不是 NSAID 特定风险。patients in our scenario. Because each task conditions on a specific treatment, these predictions stratify within a treated cohort rather than across drugs. Therefore, the risk scores likely reflect a combination of baseline patient health and treatment-specific factors: patients at higher risk of adverse events from NSAIDs, for example, may have underlying conditions that predispose them to adverse events in general, rather than NSAID-specific risk.

APOLLO 用于临床运营管理APOLLO for clinical operations management

我们评估了 12 项反映短期院内结果和资源需求的运营任务（We evaluate 12 operational tasks that reflect short-term in-hospital outcomes and resource demands (图 3h，扩展数据表 14Figure 3h, Extended Data Table 14）。这些任务包括预测 30 天内的全因住院患者再入院、7 天以上的住院时间以及 10 个急性护理终点，我们预测终点是否会在急诊科 (ED) 入院后 7 天内发生。对于住院时间和急性护理终点，我们提供 ED 入院后 24 小时内的患者病史作为模型的输入，因此有效阈值持续时间为 6 天。由于这些任务的审查非常严格，发生率低至 0.01%，因此我们使用平衡准确度来报告性能（更多详细信息，请参阅第 1 节）). These tasks include predicting all-cause inpatient readmission within 30 days, inpatient length of stay over 7 days, and 10 acute care endpoints where we predict whether the endpoint will occur within 7 days of emergency department (ED) admission. For the length of stay and acute care endpoints, we provide the patient history up to 24 hours after ED admission as input into the model, thus the effective threshold duration is 6 days. Since the censorship is substantial for these tasks, with incidences as low as 0.01%, we report performance using balanced accuracy (for more details see Section指标Metrics in 在线方法Online Methods）。总体而言，APOLLO 在 12 种设置中的 9 种中取得了显着改进。特别是，院内透析依赖的平衡准确度从 0.65 增加到 0.97，急性肾衰竭的平衡准确度从 0.64 增加到 0.80，脓毒症的平衡准确度从 0.66 增加到 0.79（所有). Overall, APOLLO yields significant improvements in 9 out of 12 settings. In particular, balanced accuracy increases from 0.65 to 0.97 for in-hospital dialysis dependence, 0.64 to 0.80 for acute kidney failure, and 0.66 to 0.79 for sepsis (allp < 0 .0001）。对于更广泛的运营指标，该模型改进了对延长住院时间（0.63 至 0.76）和 30 天内全因再入院（0.54 至 0.62；两者）的预测。0001). For broader operational metrics, the model improves prediction of prolonged hospital stay (0.63 to 0.76) and all-cause readmission within 30 days (0.54 to 0.62; bothp < 0 .0001）。所有实验的结果可以在0001). Results for all experiments can be found in扩展数据表 15Extended Data Table 15。总而言之，这些发现表明，学习到的时间患者表征在药理学环境和时间尺度上具有普遍性，可能为未来医院运营的优化提供基础。. Taken together, these findings indicate that the learned temporal patient representations generalize across pharmacologic settings and time scales, potentially providing a basis for the optimization of hospital operations in the future.

APOLLO 的风险评分对患者群体进行分层并经过良好校准APOLLO’s risk scores stratify patient groups and are well-calibrated

为了评估 APOLLO 的风险预测是否可用于患者分层，我们根据预测的风险评分将患者队列分为低风险组和高风险组。我们分别为高风险组和低风险组选择风险分数最高和最低的 25%（To assess whether the risk prediction with APOLLO can be used for patient stratification, we divide the patient cohort into low and high-risk groups based on the predicted risk scores. We select the top and bottom 25% of risk scores for the high- and low-risk groups, respectively (扩展数据图 1 至 8Extended Data Figures 1 to 8）。由于在现实场景中许多终点的发生率非常低，因此可以通过使用小于 25% 的分数来改善分层。在所有任务组中，我们观察到 APOLLO 的风险评分很好地对患者队列进行了分层，特别是对于审查制度较低的任务，例如癌症死亡率、心力衰竭死亡率（). Since the prevalence of many endpoints is very low in real-world scenarios, the stratification could be improved by using a fraction smaller than 25%. Across all sets of tasks, we observe that the risk scores of APOLLO stratify the patient cohorts well, particularly for tasks with lower censorship, e.g., cancer mortality, heart failure mortality (扩展数据图3Extended Data Figure 3）。校准指标进一步证实模型的风险评分在所有任务组中都得到了很好的校准，我们观察到样本量较大的任务比患者较少的任务校准得更好（). Calibration metrics further confirm that the risk scores of the model are wellcalibrated across all groups of tasks, where we observe that tasks with larger sample sizes are better calibrated than tasks with fewer patients (扩展数据图 9 至 16Extended Data Figures 9 to 16 ).

消融研究Ablation studies

跨模式的语义对齐对于对具有固有多模式诊断的疾病（例如肿瘤）进行建模至关重要。在评估长达五年的长期风险预测时，跨模式了解患者的健康状况并对患者病史的时间背景进行建模非常重要。至Semantic alignment across modalities is crucial for modeling diseases with inherently multimodal diagnostics such as neoplasms. When assessing long term risk predictions on durations up to five years, understanding the patient health state across modalities and modeling the temporal context of the patient history is important. 为了量化模型中每个组成部分的贡献，我们对肿瘤疾病进展任务集（包括 28 个下游任务）进行了一系列消融。我们将 APOLLO 的完整版本与（i）使用相同预训练目标训练的纯结构化数据模型进行比较，（ii）具有相同架构的监督模型，在每个单独的任务上进行端到端训练，（iii）使用嵌入最新进度说明的进度说明基线，以及（iv）年龄性别基线（quantify the contribution of each component of our model, we perform a series of ablations on the neoplasm disease progression task set comprising 28 downstream tasks. We compare the full version of APOLLO to (i) a structured-data-only model trained with the same pretraining objectives, (ii) a supervised model with the same architecture trained end-to-end on each individual task, (iii) a progress-note baseline using the embedding of the most recent progress note, and (iv) the age-sex baseline (图 3i，扩展数据 图 17Figure 3i, Extended Data Figure 17 ).

最大的进步出现在血液恶性肿瘤中：对于慢性粒细胞白血病死亡率，APOLLO 比进度记录模型提高了 +0.31 AUROC，比监督模型提高了 +0.23。对于实体瘤，APOLLO 在乳腺癌姑息治疗方面优于监督基线 +0.16，在结直肠癌死亡率方面优于监督基线 +0.13，在膀胱癌转移方面优于监督基线 +0.12。仅通过结构化数据就可以很好地捕获前列腺癌的生存预测（所有模式的 AUROC 为 0.83 对比 0.84），而黑色素瘤和乳腺癌的生存则从多模式整合中获益更多（分别为 +0.07 和 +0.06 AUROC）。这些结果表明，多模式、时间情境化预训练的好处在癌症类型和临床终点上一致延伸。The strongest gains appear in hematologic malignancies: for chronic myeloid leukemia mortality, APOLLO improves over the progress note model by +0.31 AUROC and over the supervised model by +0.23. For solid tumors, APOLLO outperforms the supervised baseline by +0.16 on breast cancer palliative care, +0.13 on colorectal cancer mortality, and +0.12 on bladder cancer metastasis. Survival prediction for prostate cancer is already well captured by structured data alone (AUROC 0.83 vs. 0.84 with all modalities), whereas melanoma and breast cancer survival benefit more substantially from multimodal integration (+0.07 and +0.06 AUROC, respectively). These results show that the benefits of multimodal, temporally contextualized pretraining extend consistently across cancer types and clinical endpoints.

在所有任务中，APOLLO 的平均 AUROC 为 0.735，比纯结构化变体提高了 +0.025 (0.71)。这凸显了我们的多模式整合结合临床记录和成像对于长期癌症进展建模的重要性。监督基线的平均 AUROC 达到 0.626 (-0.109)，这表明与我们的预训练策略相比，仅针对特定任务的微调是不够的。同样，进度记录基线平均获得 0.615 (-0.12)，年龄-性别基线达到 0.619 (-0.116)，这表明对最近遭遇之外的时间背景进行建模至关重要。总体而言，消融证实多模式集成、时间建模和大规模预训练都是 APOLLO 的必要组成部分，每一项都对准确的长期癌症进展风险评估做出了重大贡献。Across all tasks, APOLLO achieves a mean AUROC of 0.735 improving over the structured-only variant by +0.025 (0.71). This highlights the importance of our multimodal integration incorporating clinical notes and imaging for modeling long-term cancer progression. The supervised baseline reaches a mean AUROC of 0.626 (-0.109), indicating that task-specific fine-tuning alone is insufficient compared to our pretraining strategy. Similarly, the progress note baseline obtains 0.615 on average (-0.12) and the age-sex baseline achieves 0.619 (-0.116), demonstrating that modeling temporal context beyond the most recent encounter is essential. Overall, the ablations confirm that multimodal integration, temporal modeling, and large-scale pretraining are all necessary components of APOLLO, each contributing substantially to accurate long-term cancer progression risk assessment.

患者级别的表示支持语义搜索Patient-level representations enable semantic search

上述预后评估测试了 APOLLO 嵌入是否编码了预测未来临床事件的信息。一个补充问题是学习的嵌入空间是否根据过去的临床事件编码患者之间的相似性。检索任务通过使用最近邻搜索直接查询嵌入空间来探测这一点。我们测量返回的患者是否具有与查询相似的临床特征。强大的检索性能将支持 APOLLO 的实用性，不仅可以用于预测，还可以用于队列发现、临床试验匹配和医学推理。The prognostic evaluations above test whether APOLLO embeddings encode information predictive of future clinical events. A complementary question is whether the learned embedding space encodes similarities between patients based on past clinical events. Retrieval tasks probe this by querying the embedding space directly using nearest-neighbor search. We measure whether the returned patients have similar clinical profiles as the query. Strong retrieval performance would support the utility of APOLLO not only for prediction but also for cohort discovery, clinical trial matching, and medical reasoning.

通过将整个病史压缩为单个向量，我们可以通过余弦距离量化任意两个患者的相似度，从而执行语义检索。为了模拟临床部署场景，我们构建了一个由 140 万名患者的整个评估集组成的搜索索引，每个患者都嵌入在 2025 年 1 月 1 日的日历时间。我们策划了 61 个患者队列，这些患者队列由特定诊断定义，然后接受一线治疗。这些纳入标准是通过 SQL 从结构化医疗事件中提取的。我们将每个队列分成五个相等的折叠，并将其中一个折叠的每个成员设置为查询并检索By compressing entire medical histories into a single vector, we can quantify the similarity of any two patients via cosine distance and thus perform semantic retrieval. To mimic a clinical deployment scenario, we construct a search index composed of the entire evaluation set of 1.4 million patients, each embedded at the calendar time of January 1st, 2025. We curated 61 patient cohorts defined by a particular diagnosis followed by administration of a first-line therapy. These inclusion criteria are extracted from the structured medical events via SQL. We divide each cohort into five equal folds, and set each member of one fold as the queries and retrieve the

图4：Figure 4:APOLLO 增强了患者检索。APOLLO enhances patient retrieval.(a) 根据 ICD10 诊断代码和药物组合策划的 61 名患者检索任务，与最新进展记录嵌入的检索相比，对五位最接近 (Acc@5) 嵌入患者的准确性进行评估，(b) 对最接近嵌入患者与肾移植维护患者的定性评估。 (c) 使用 APOLLO 治疗评估计划标记作为最后提示，对临床试验纳入标准示例进行基于文本的检索。 (d) 使用来自 TCGA 的外部全幻灯片图像进行基于图像的检索，并使用相应的 TITAN 嵌入 [43] 作为最后一个标记。为了保护患者隐私，图中显示的年龄与实际年龄随机移动 -2 至 2 岁，实验室测试和生命体征值以范围而不是确切数字的形式呈现。(a) 61 patient retrieval tasks curated from combinations of ICD10 diagnosis codes and medications, assessed with accuracy among the five closest (Acc@5) embedded patients compared to retrieval of the latest progress note embedding, (b) qualitative evaluation of the closest embedded patient to a patient for kidney transplant maintenance. (c) Text-based retrieval on the example of a clinical trial inclusion criteria using APOLLO treatment assessment plan token as the last prompt. (d) Image-based retrieval using an external whole-slide image from TCGA using the corresponding TITAN embedding [43] as last token. To preserve patient privacy, ages shown in the figure are randomly shifted by -2 to 2 years from their actual age, and lab test and vitals values are presented as ranges instead of exact numbers.

从搜索索引的其余部分中找到最相似的患者（有关更多详细信息，请参阅第most similar patients from the remainder of the search index (for more details see Section检索Retrieval in 在线方法Online Methods）。我们计算语义检索到的前 5 名患者与结构化纳入标准定义的队列之间的一致性。作为基线，我们使用 2025 年 1 月 1 日之前最新进度说明的单峰嵌入构建搜索索引（). We compute the agreement between the top-5 semantically retrieved patients and the cohort defined by the structured inclusion criteria. As a baseline, we construct a search index using the unimodal embedding of the most recent progress note prior to 1/1/2025 (图 4a，扩展数据 图 18Figure 4a, Extended Data Figure 18 ).

与基线相比，使用 APOLLO 嵌入整个患者病史可以在所有任务中与 SQL 真实队列产生更高的一致性，并且对于影响患者健康更严重的疾病实现特别高的检索性能。表现最好的队列包括肿瘤（卡铂治疗卵巢癌、硼替佐米治疗多发性骨髓瘤、阿糖胞苷治疗急性髓性白血病）、循环系统疾病（阿司匹林治疗慢性缺血性心脏病、阿哌沙班治疗心房颤动、赖诺普利治疗高血压）以及代谢和内分泌疾病（阿托伐他汀治疗血脂、阿托伐他汀治疗甲状腺功能减退）左旋甲状腺素和 T2DM 服用二甲双胍）。相比之下，对于不太严重的疾病（例如缺铁性贫血或维生素 B12 缺乏性贫血），检索性能较低。这些趋势表明患者状态主要是Compared to the baseline, embedding the entire patient history using APOLLO yields higher agreement with the SQL ground-truth cohorts across all tasks and achieves particularly high retrieval performance for diseases which more severely affect patient health. The top-performing cohorts include neoplasms (ovarian cancer on carboplatin, multiple myeloma on bortezomib, acute myeloid leukemia on cytarabine), circulatory diseases (chronic ischemic heart disease on aspirin, atrial fibrillation on apixaban, and hypertension on lisinopril), and metabolic and endocrine conditions (lipidemia on atorvastatin, hypothyroidism on levothyroxine, and T2DM on metformin). In contrast, lower retrieval performances are observed for less-serious conditions such as iron deficiency anemia or vitamin B12 deficiency anemia. These trends suggest that the patient state is primarily

接下来我们更深入地研究一些定性检索结果（We next take a deeper look at some qualitative retrieval results (图4bFigure 4b）。我们的查询患者是一位 60-70 岁的患者。男性，有慢性肾病和急性肾衰竭病史，并服用他克莫司以预防肾移植后的器官排斥（ICD10代码Z94.0）。最接近的前 4 位患者（使用 APOLLO 嵌入检索）拥有 47,000 到 308,000 条事件的医疗记录。所有四名患者均表现出慢性肾脏病、急性肾衰竭和肾透析依赖病史，与查询患者非常相似。这些结果还表明，在某些情况下，语义相似度可以检索基于结构化数据的传统 SQL 方法遗漏的相关患者。例如，第二位患者缺少肾移植的 ICD10 代码 (Z94.0)，尽管有肾移植并发症 (T86.19) 和肾透析 (Z99.2) 病史，随后开了他克莫司处方。如果我们仅根据ICD10代码Z94.0检索类似患者，那么该患者就会被漏掉。). Our query patient is a 60-70 y.o. male with a history of chronic kidney disease and acute kidney failure, and was prescribed tacrolimus to prevent organ rejection following a kidney transplant (ICD10 code Z94.0). The top-4 closest patients (retrieved using APOLLO embeddings) have medical records ranging from 47 thousand to 308 thousand events. All four patients show histories of chronic kidney disease, acute kidney failure, and dependence on renal dialysis, which are very similar to the query patient. These results also show that semantic similarity in some cases can retrieve relevant patients which are missed by traditional SQL methods based on structured data. For example, the second patient is missing the ICD10 code for kidney transplant (Z94.0), despite having a history of kidney transplant complications (T86.19) and renal dialysis (Z99.2), followed by a prescription for tacrolimus. If we were to retrieve similar patients based only on the ICD10 code Z94.0, this patient would be missed.

除了使用查询患者进行检索之外，APOLLO 还支持使用任意模式进行检索，特别是文本（Besides retrieval using a query patient, APOLLO also enables retrieval using arbitrary modalities, in particular text (图4cFigure 4c）和图像（) and images (图4dFigure 4d）。例如，我们可以用自然语言编写一组包含标准并将其嵌入为查询（). For example, we can write a set of inclusion criteria in natural language and embed it as the query (图4cFigure 4c）。为了生成搜索索引，我们使用相应的模态作为提示标记（即屏蔽文本提示而不是屏蔽诊断提示）来为评估集中的每个患者生成嵌入。检索到的前四名患者均表现出符合所需纳入标准的病史，包括尽管接受了他汀类药物治疗，但仍存在高 LDL 胆固醇，以及可能或已确诊的动脉粥样硬化性心脏病。此外，我们可以使用单个病理切片作为查询（). To generate the search index, we use the corresponding modality as the prompt token (i.e., masked text prompt instead of masked diagnosis prompt) to generate embeddings for every patient in the evaluation set. The top four retrieved patients all exhibit medical histories which align with the desired inclusion criteria, including high LDL cholesterol despite statin therapy, and likely or confirmed atherosclerotic heart disease. Additionally, we can use a single pathology slide as the query (图4dFigure 4d）。在本例中，我们使用 TCGA 中的幻灯片而不是我们的评估集中的幻灯片来测试 APOLLO 嵌入的外部泛化性。与文本检索实验类似，我们利用蒙版图像提示标记来生成搜索索引的患者嵌入。检索到的最多患者均表现出 TCGA 幻灯片中所示的病理：IV 级胶质母细胞瘤。此外，前 4 名检索到的患者中至少有 3 名与 TCGA 载玻片的 IDH 野生型状态特异性一致。由于不存在 R132H 突变且存在 +7/-10 染色体拷贝数变异特征，第二名患者被确认为 IDH 野生型。第三名和第四名患者的 IDH1 R132H 呈阴性，这意味着可能处于野生型状态。总之，APOLLO 患者嵌入使用不同的查询模式解锁可扩展的语义相似性搜索，范围从单个文本描述或图像到整个患者病史。). In this case, we use a slide from TCGA rather than from our evaluation set, to test the external generalizability of APOLLO embeddings. Similarly to the text-retrieval experiment, we utilize the masked image prompt token to generate the patient embeddings for the search index. The top retrieved patients all exhibit the pathology indicated in the TCGA slide: Grade IV Glioblastoma. Furthermore, at least three of the top 4 retrieved patients specifically align with the IDH wildtype status of the TCGA slide. The second patient is confirmed IDH wildtype due to absence of the R132H mutation and the presence of the +7/-10 chromosomal copy number variant signature. The third and fourth patients are IDH1 R132H negative which implies likely wildtype status. In summary, APOLLO patient embeddings unlock scalable semantic similarity search using diverse query modalities, ranging from a single textual description or image to an entire patient history.

到 70 年代后期，风险一直保持在接近于零的水平，然后在记录原发性高血压、血脂异常和 2 型糖尿病后上升，并因 eGFR 下降至 50 多岁以下以及多种心脏代谢合并症的发现以及随后重复的腰痛评估而再次跳跃。这些标志共同反映了在长期存在的血管危险因素背景下出现的慢性肾损伤。对于肺癌的发病（risk remained near zero through late 70s, then rose after documentation of essential hypertension, dyslipidaemia, and type 2 diabetes, and jumped again on a decline in eGFR to the low 50s and the findings of multiple cardiometabolic comorbidities, followed by repeated flank-pain evaluations. These tokens together reflect the emergence of chronic kidney damage on a background of long-standing vascular risk factors. For onset of lung cancer (图5bFigure 5b），几十年来风险一直保持在较低水平，然后随着吸烟和既往乳腺癌以及原发性高血压的发现而增加。随后的急剧上升来自慢性阻塞性肺病、肺气肿和不断扩大的、富含 FDG 的肺结节的系列报告，这反映了肺癌的临床检查。对于心力衰竭（), risk stayed low for decades, then increased with findings of smoking and prior breast cancer, and essential hypertension. Subsequent sharp rises came from COPD, emphysema and serial reports of an enlarging, FDG-avid lung nodule, mirroring the clinical work-up of incident lung cancer. For heart failure (图5cFigure 5c），超声心动图显示严重主动脉瓣狭窄、持续吸烟和慢性阻塞性肺病，以及随后持续拒绝瓣膜介入、进行性充血和血栓形成，风险就会升级。此外，LOTO 分析还证明了保护性事件，例如 CKD 的临界 eGFR 和正常血清碱性磷酸酶水平。值得注意的是，除了典型的驱动因素之外，贡献最大的因素还包括与疾病有明确关联的医疗事件。虽然其中一些可能是强化监测或治疗标志等代理指标，但有些反映了合并症集群或共同的风险环境，少数可能代表了未来研究的假设生成信号。), risk escalated following echocardiography evidence of severe aortic stenosis, ongoing smoking and COPD, and subsequent persistent refusal of valve intervention, progressive congestion and thrombosis. Additionally, the LOTO analysis also demonstrated protective events, such as borderline eGFR and normal serum alkaline phosphatase levels for CKD. It is worth noting that, besides canonical drivers, the top contributors also include medical events with clear associations with the diseases. While some of them are likely proxies such as markers of intensified surveillance or treatment, some reflect comorbidity clusters or shared risk environments, and a minority may represent hypothesis-generating signals for future study.

接下来，我们使用积分梯度（IG）来量化属于最高危险四分位的高风险患者在人群水平上的特征重要性，IG是根据 Transformer 前的输入计算的，并通过嵌入维度、归一化和每个患者的最大池化的净总和进行聚合，并在整个人群中进行平均（更多详细信息请参阅第 1 节）We next quantify feature importance at the population level for high risk patients that fall in the top hazard quartile using Integrated Gradients (IG) computed on the pre-Transformer inputs and aggregated by net sum across embedding dimensions, normalization and max-pooled per patient, and averaged across the population (for more details see Section可解释性Interpretability in 在线方法Online Methods）。跨越六项代表性任务（). Across six representative tasks (图5d-iFigure 5d-i），APOLLO 恢复了临床上一致的风险结构。对于从慢性阻塞性肺病进展为呼吸衰竭（), APOLLO recovers clinically coherent risk structure. For progression from COPD to respiratory failure (图5dFigure 5d），静脉血栓栓塞、心动过速、肺部影像异常、严重高血压和 COVID-19 的相对贡献较高，这与心肺劳损和并发感染导致失代偿一致。包括低血清铁和缺铁性贫血在内的生物标志物与最近的研究结果一致，表明慢性阻塞性肺病中缺铁很常见，并且与较差的运动能力、病情恶化和预后相关[47, 48]。对于从心力衰竭进展为急性肾衰竭（), high relative contributions are assigned to venous thromboembolism, tachycardia, abnormal lung imaging, severe hypertension and COVID-19, consistent with cardiopulmonary strain and intercurrent infection precipitating decompensation. Biomarkers including low serum iron and iron-deficiency anaemia are in line with recent works showing that iron deficiency in COPD is common and associated with worse exercise capacity, exacerbations, and prognosis [47, 48]. For progression from heart failure to acute kidney failure (图5eFigure 5e），IG 强调肥胖、术后状态和年龄指标，包括脂溢性角化病、指甲疾病、骨关节炎、玻璃体疾病和带状疱疹。虽然这些可能部分反映了虚弱和医疗保健接触，但一些皮肤病学和指甲检查结果已被提议作为动脉粥样硬化和退行性心血管疾病（包括心力衰竭）的皮肤标志物[49, 50]。用于从 2 型糖尿病进展为糖尿病足溃疡（), IG highlights obesity, post-procedural states and age proxies including seborrhoeic keratoses, nail disorders, osteoarthritis, vitreous body disease and zoster. While these likely partly reflect frailty and healthcare contact, several dermatologic and nail findings have been proposed as cutaneous markers of atherosclerotic and degenerative cardiovascular disease, including heart failure [49, 50]. For progression from type 2 diabetes to diabetic foot ulcer (图5fFigure 5f），主要的危险因素是动脉粥样硬化、血管成像、极端血压和红细胞指数，反映大血管疾病、血流动力学负荷和全身炎症，所有这些都是糖尿病足的潜在病理学[51]。痛风也出现在最主要的诱因之中，这与最近的研究一致，表明糖尿病中的痛风与血管并发症、神经病变和高危糖尿病足有关，并且痛风石性痛风可以模仿或加重足部溃疡 [52, 53]。对于乳腺癌曲妥珠单抗的生存率（), the dominant risk factors are atherosclerosis, vascular imaging, blood-pressure extremes and red-cell indices, reflecting macrovascular disease, haemodynamic load and systemic inflammation, all known to underlying diabetic foot pathology [51]. Gout also appears among the top contributors, which aligns with recent studies showing that gout in diabetes are linked to vascular complications, neuropathy and a high-risk diabetic foot, and that tophaceous gout can mimic or worsen foot ulcers [52, 53]. For survival on trastuzumab in breast cancer (图5gFigure 5g），IG 主要表现宿主因素，包括高血压、2 型糖尿病、慢性肾病和既往恶性肿瘤，这与心脏代谢合并症和合并症负担影响 HER2 阳性乳腺癌的治疗耐受性和总体生存率的数据一致 [54-56]。口腔疼痛等症状似乎反映了治疗过程中的粘膜毒性和治疗强度。对于使用 atezolizumab 治疗肺癌和使用 nivolumab 治疗黑色素瘤的生存率（), IG primarily surfaces host factors including high blood pressures, type 2 diabetes, chronic kidney disease and prior malignancy, consistent with data that cardiometabolic comorbidities and comorbidity burden influence both treatment tolerance and overall survival in HER2-positive breast cancer [54–56]. Symptoms such as mouth pain plausibly capture mucosal toxicity and treatment intensity over the course of therapy. For survival on atezolizumab in lung cancer and nivolumab in melanoma (图5h，iFigure 5h,i），主要标志包括高血压、憩室病、), the dominant tokens include high blood pressures, diverticular disease,

16

肾结石、疼痛和肌肉骨骼诊断，以及红斑痤疮和肥厚性皮肤病等炎症性皮肤病。同样，这些模式与基线合并症和功能状态影响免疫治疗结果的事实相呼应[55, 57]，也与越来越多的文献将皮肤免疫相关不良事件（包括酒渣鼻样皮疹和其他炎症性皮肤病）与免疫检查点抑制剂的有利生存联系起来[58, 59]。为了进一步研究这些发现的普遍性，我们检查了其他本地和全球的例子，包括转移性肺癌的 3 年死亡率和卵巢癌转移的 IG 概况、蒽环类心肌病、主动脉瓣狭窄后的生存率以及阿哌沙班的无卒中/栓塞生存率，所有这些都显示出对临床合理的驱动因素、多发病集群和护理过程代理的相似集中归因。kidney stones, pain and musculoskeletal diagnoses, as well as inflammatory skin conditions such as rosacea and hypertrophic skin disorders. Similarly, these patterns resonate with the facts that baseline comorbidity and functional status shape immunotherapy outcomes [55, 57], and with a growing literature linking cutaneous immune-related adverse events, including rosacea like eruptions and other inflammatory dermatoses to favourable survival on immune checkpoint inhibitors [58, 59]. To further investigate the generalization of these findings, we check additional local and global examples, including 3-year mortality in metastatic lung cancer and IG profiles for ovarian cancer metastasis, anthracycline cardiomyopathy, survival after aortic stenosis, and stroke/embolism-free survival with apixaban, all of which show similar concentration of attribution on clinically plausible drivers, multimorbidity clusters and care-process proxies (扩展数据 图 19Extended Data Figure 19 ).

除了这些预期和最近报告的关联之外，IG 始终呈现最能解释为护理过程代理的标记，例如术后状态和设备相关代码、多发病标记和共享风险环境（例如心脏代谢面板中的精神病、肌肉骨骼或胃肠道诊断），以及一小组没有明显机制联系的特征。因此，我们将这些归因视为从 EHR 中学到的关联结构，而不是因果效应：它们表明患者记录的哪些方面最能推动 APOLLO 下的预测，强调与已确定的风险因素和新的流行病学观察的一致性，并提名一些特征，例如 COPD 中的缺铁或心力衰竭中的皮肤/指甲老化标志物，作为未来临床研究的可测试的、假设生成的信号。Beyond these expected and recently reported associations, IG consistently surfaces tokens that are best interpreted as proxies for care processes such as post-procedural states and device-related codes, markers of multimorbidity and shared risk environments such as psychiatric, musculoskeletal or gastrointestinal diagnoses in cardiometabolic panels, and a small set of features with no obvious mechanistic link. We therefore treat these attributions as associative structure learned from the EHR rather than causal effects: they indicate which aspects of a patient’s record most drive predictions under APOLLO, highlight concordance with established risk factors and newer epidemiological observations, and nominate a handful of features such as iron deficiency in COPD or skin/nail aging markers in heart failure as testable, hypothesis-generating signals for future clinical studies.

本地和全球分析共同表明，APOLLO 的预测是可审计的：在床边，临床医生可以检查患者风险上升的原因，而在规模上，研究人员可以恢复与临床知识相符的人群水平结构，同时也揭示可测试的、假设生成的信号。如果基础模型要支持临床决策和发现而不是作为不透明的黑匣子运行，那么这些属性至关重要。Together, the local and global analyses show that APOLLO’s predictions are auditable: at the bedside, clinicians can inspect why a patient’s risk rose when it did, and at scale, investigators can recover population-level structure that aligns with clinical knowledge while also revealing testable, hypothesis-generating signals. These properties are essential if foundation models are to support clinical decision-making and discovery rather than operate as opaque black boxes.

17

讨论Discussion

在这项工作中，我们引入了 APOLLO，这是第一个多模态基础模型，它将患者数据的完整纵向轨迹集成到统一的时间患者表示中。通过对超过 250 亿个医疗事件（涵盖来自超过 700 万患者的临床记录、影像和结构化记录）进行训练和评估，我们证明可以将这些碎片化的数据模式从单峰数据孤岛整合到一个具有计算意义的表示空间中。这种统一的表示可以构成人工智能精准医疗的基础，支持从早期疾病检测到治疗反应分层的广泛临床任务。 APOLLO 的虚拟患者代表可以根据新的临床事件不断更新，将医疗保健从被动的、间歇性的治疗转变为主动、持续的风险管理。此外，这些通用表示也为临床研究开辟了新领域。例如，通过准确识别具有相似复杂多模式表型的患者，APOLLO 可以轻松增强临床试验匹配，帮助解决招募中持续存在的瓶颈。例如，即使结构化编码不完整，APOLLO 的语义检索也能识别临床上相似的患者，正如对缺乏相应 ICD-10 代码的肾移植患者的检索所证明的那样（In this work, we introduce APOLLO, the first multimodal foundation model that integrates the complete longitudinal trajectory of patient data into a unified temporal patient representation. By training and evaluating on over 25 billion medical events spanning clinical notes, imaging, and structured records from more than 7 million patients, we demonstrate that it is possible to consolidate these fragmented data modalities from unimodal data silos into a single computationally meaningful representation space. This unified representation can form the basis of AI-enabled precision medicine, empowering a vast spectrum of clinical tasks from early disease detection to treatment response stratification. APOLLO’s virtual patient representations can continuously be updated with new clinical events, shifting healthcare from reactive, episodic treatment to proactive, continuous risk management. Moreover, these general-purpose representations also open new frontiers for clinical research. For example, by accurately identifying patients with similar complex multimodal phenotypes, APOLLO can readily enhance clinical trial matching, helping to resolve persistent bottlenecks in recruitment. For instance, APOLLO’s semantic retrieval identifies clinically similar patients even when structured coding is incomplete, as demonstrated by retrieval of a kidney transplant patient lacking the corresponding ICD-10 code (图4Figure 4b).从长远来看，这种能力可以为下一代试验设计奠定基础，包括b). In the longer term, this capability could lay the groundwork for next-generation trial designs, including计算机模拟in silico患者队列水平的试验模拟和个体水平的高度个性化的治疗反应预测，有可能降低为患者提供新疗法的成本和持续时间。trial simulation at patient cohort level and highly personalized treatment response prediction at the individual level, potentially reducing the cost and duration of bringing new therapies to patients.

除了预测效用之外，APOLLO 还让我们一睹统一多模式数据中生物医学发现的潜力。该模型在输入（医疗事件）和输出（患者）级别的新兴嵌入空间反映了个体医学概念和患者级别表型之间的语义关系。患者层面（通过 LOTO）和人群层面（通过积分梯度）的可解释性分析提供了对模型决策的一些见解，并为多模式风险预测模型的可信应用奠定了基础，作为使用一组有限的手动策划特征的已建立临床风险评分的演变。超越手动策划的特征集是可取的，不仅因为考虑到更多输入数据而可能具有更高的准确性，而且因为它提供了一种识别新型生物标志物并利用它们获得潜在治疗益处的机制。Beyond predictive utility, APOLLO provides a glimpse of the potential for biomedical discovery from unified multimodal data. The model’s emergent embedding spaces, both at the input (medical event) and output (patient) level, reflects semantic relationships among individual medical concepts and patient-level phenotypes. The interpretability analyses, both at the patient level (via LOTO) and population level (via Integrated Gradients), provide some insight into model decision-making and lay the foundation for trustworthy application of multimodal risk-prediction models as an evolution of established clinical risk scores that use a limited set of manually curated features. Moving beyond manually curated feature sets is desirable not only because of the potentially higher accuracy as more input data is taken into account, but also because it provides a mechanism for identifying novel biomarkers and utilizing them for potential therapeutic benefit.

尽管这项技术具有潜力，但仍有许多工作要做。首先，经过严格观察数据的训练，APOLLO 学会做出关联而非因果的预测。例如，此处评估的治疗反应预测代表患者之间的预后分层，而不是不同药物之间的疗效估计。换句话说，该模型可能主要学习预测哪些患者将对特定药物产生反应，但不能预测哪种药物将是特定患者的最佳选择。这是由于我们训练数据的特点：前一种能力是从任何给定药物（我们拥有）的多个可比患者的患者时间线中学习的，而后者需要同一患者的多个可比药物的结果数据（这要难得多）。虽然对患者分层很有价值，但必须注意不要在没有进一步因果验证的情况下将检索到的风险因素解释为干预的直接目标。预测同一患者不同疗法的不同结果的反事实任务将是这项工作的重要延伸。Despite the potential of this technology, much work remains to be done. First, being trained on strictly observational data, APOLLO learns to make predictions that are associational, not causal. For example, treatment response prediction as evaluated here represents prognostic stratification across patients rather than efficacy estimation across different drugs. In other words, the model may primarily learn to predict which patients will respond to a particular drug, but not which drug will be the best choice for a given patient. This is due to the characteristics of our training data: the former capability is learned from patient timelines of multiple comparable patients for any given drug (which we have) while the latter requires outcome data of multiple comparable drugs for the same patient (which are far more difficult to obtain). While valuable for patient stratification, care must be taken not to interpret retrieved risk factors as direct targets for intervention without further causal validation. The counterfactual task of predicting differential outcomes across therapies for the same patient will be an important extension of this work.

18

在数据方面，尽管训练数据集涵盖 17 家医院和附属诊所，但所有数据均来自在共享 Epic EHR 平台上运行的单一伞式医疗保健系统（Mass General Brigham）。因此，本评价反映了系统内的普遍性。 MGB 捕获的患者群体虽然在许多方面存在差异，但仍然主要代表美国东北部。在培训期间纳入来自其他卫生系统和护理机构的多机构数据将是扩大所学表征的地理和操作范围的重要方向。On the data side, although the training dataset spans 17 hospitals and affiliated clinics, all data come from a single umbrella healthcare system (Mass General Brigham) operating on a shared Epic EHR platform. Accordingly, the present evaluation reflects within-system generalization. The patient population captured by MGB, while heterogeneous in many respects, is still primarily representative of the northeastern United States. Incorporating multi-institution data from additional health systems and care settings during training will be an important direction for broadening the geographic and operational scope of the learned representations.

在风险预测领域，当前的基准测试框架旨在对广泛且多样化的 261 项预后任务进行高通量评估，并以年龄和性别作为通用统计参考。对于心力衰竭、中风和急性心肌梗死等经过充分研究的终点，经过验证的临床风险工具（例如 ASCVD、CHA2DS2-VASc、HEART 评分、Framingham）是天然的比较工具。我们在这里不进行头对头比较，因为大规模计算这些分数需要特定于端点的输入，而这些输入并不能在整个队列中一致地捕获为结构化变量。然而，我们的可解释性分析恢复了这些既定分数中嵌入的许多相同的风险因素（In the realm of risk prediction, the current benchmarking framework is designed to enable high-throughput evaluation across a broad and diverse set of 261 prognostic tasks, with age and sex serving as a common statistical reference. For well-studied endpoints such as heart failure, stroke, and acute MI, validated clinical risk tools (e.g., ASCVD, CHA2DS2-VASc, HEART score, Framingham) are the natural comparators. We do not perform head-to-head comparisons here, as computing these scores at scale requires endpoint-specific inputs that are not consistently captured as structured variables across the full cohort. However, our interpretability analyses recover many of the same risk factors embedded in these established scores (图5Figure 5），提供机械对齐的早期证据并激发未来工作中的直接比较。), providing early evidence of mechanistic alignment and motivating direct comparisons in future work.

在建模方面，在处理长序列的综合多模态患者轨迹数据时，我们的设计选择必然受到计算可行性的限制。因此，我们使用冻结的、预训练的、现成的单峰编码器来提高计算效率。直接在域内 EHR 数据上微调或预训练这些编码器的未来迭代可能会产生更优越、更有效的表示。类似地，我们使用基本聚合技术（例如平均文档块嵌入）对高密度模式（例如长临床记录）进行编码。实施更复杂、可学习的聚合规则可以释放更细粒度的信号。最后，我们的研究没有明确纳入来自可穿戴设备的数据流、有关生活方式的信息或患者与提供者的对话。未来的工作应该通过额外的架构创新来解决这些限制。On the modeling side, our design choices are necessarily constrained by computational feasibility when dealing with long sequences of comprehensive multimodal patient trajectory data. As a result, we use frozen, pre-trained, off-the-shelf unimodal encoders for computational efficiency. Future iterations that fine-tune or pre-train these encoders directly on in-domain EHR data would likely yield superior and more efficient representations. Similarly, we encode high-density modalities (such as long clinical notes) using basic aggregation techniques, such as averaging document chunk embeddings. Implementing more sophisticated, learnable aggregation rules could unlock more fine-grained signals. Finally, our study does not explicitly incorporate data streams from wearables, information about lifestyle, or patient-provider conversations. Future work should address these limitations via additional architectural innovations.

最终，这里介绍的培训范式和广泛的评估流程表明，将静态 EHR 档案转换为统一的纵向虚拟患者表示在医疗保健系统规模上是可行的，为整个临床护理领域的人工智能精准医疗奠定了基础。Ultimately, the training paradigm and broad evaluation pipeline presented here demonstrate that converting the static EHR archive into unified, longitudinal virtual patient representations is feasible at healthcare-system scale, establishing a foundation for AI-enabled precision medicine across the full spectrum of clinical care.

数据集描述Dataset description

我们从麻省总医院布里格姆 (MGB) 医疗保健系统收集了大规模、多模式电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据集 MGB-7M。该数据集包含 7,155,044 名患者，从 1992 年到 2025 年，各种方式总共发生 25,296,943,893 起临床事件，最长的患者记录跨越 33 年。 MGB-7M 由 28 种不同的模式组成，包括诊断、药物、实验室测试、生命体征和流程图等结构化记录，以及非结构化医疗记录和成像数据。患者人口统计数据和 MGB-7M 模式的详细分布可以在We collected a large-scale, multimodal electronic health record (EHR) dataset, MGB-7M, from the Mass General Brigham (MGB) healthcare system. The dataset contains 7,155,044 patients with 25,296,943,893 clinical events in total across diverse modalities from 1992 to 2025, with the longest patient record spanning 33 years. MGB-7M is comprised of 28 distinct modalities, including structured records such as diagnosis, medications, lab tests, vital signs and flowsheet, as well as unstructured medical notes and imaging data. A detailed distribution of patient demographics and modalities of MGB-7M can be found in扩展数据表 1 和 2Extended Data Tables 1 and 2。数据集按 75:5:20 的比例分为训练、验证和测试部分。. The dataset was split into training, validation, and testing splits with a ratio of 75:5:20.

MGB 机构审查委员会批准了电子病历的回顾性分析。参与者没有直接参与或招募该研究。因此，放弃了分析电子病历数据的知情同意要求。The MGB institutional review board approved the retrospective analysis of the EHRs. The participants were not directly involved or recruited for the study. The requirement for informed consent to analyze the EHR data was thus waived.

数据采集和预处理Data acquisition and preprocessing

源系统和提取。Source systems and extraction.我们使用针对 Epic 运营系统的 SQL 查询从机构分析仓库 (Snowflake) 中提取 EHR 数据。在下游处理之前，原始表根据机构政策进行协调和去标识化，并清除格式不一致、重复行和不可信的时间戳。We extracted EHR data from the institutional analytics warehouse (Snowflake) using SQL queries against the operational Epic system. Raw tables were harmonized, de-identified according to institutional policy, and cleaned for format inconsistencies, duplicated rows, and implausible timestamps, before downstream processing.

方式。Modalities.该语料库包括（i）人口数据，包括性别、种族和出生日期，（ii）按时间排序的结构化数据，包括编码的诊断、编码的药物、编码的实验室测试、生命体征和流程图测量，以及（iii）包括临床文本和医学图像的按时间排序的非结构化数据，涵盖多种服务，如图所示The corpus comprised (i) demographic data including sex, ethnicity, and date of birth, (ii) temporally ordered structured data including diagnoses coded, medications coded, laboratory tests coded, vital signs, and flowsheet measurements, and (iii) temporally ordered unstructured data comprising clinical text and medical images, spanning multiple services as shown in图1b-eFigure 1b-e。成像数据包括解剖病理学全切片图像、大体图像、电子显微镜图像和血液学血涂片图像，其中我们使用原始图像及其诊断报告。对于其余的影像服务，仅使用诊断报告。. Imaging data included anatomic pathology whole slide images, gross images, electron-microscopy images, and hematology blood smear images, where we used both raw images and their diagnostic reports. For the remaining imaging services, only diagnostic reports were used.

预处理。Preprocessing.对于人口统计数据，我们将每个患者的记录时间戳转换为出生后的分钟数，并将性别（男性、女性、未知）标记为离散的分类标记。电子病历中的种族信息以多选格式记录，一名患者可以识别为多个种族。为了处理这种复杂性，我们使用 bert-base-uncased [9] 使用模板“Ethnicity:”预先嵌入每个原子种族值（例如“埃塞俄比亚人”）For demographic data, we converted each patient’s record timestamp to minutes since birth and tokenized sex (male, female, unknown) as discrete categorical tokens. Ethnicity information in the EHR was recorded in a multi-select format where one patient could identify as multiple ethnicities. To handle this complication, we pre-embedded each atomic ethnicity value (e.g., “Ethiopian”) using bert-base-uncased [9] using the template “Ethnicity:{种族ethnicity}”。这些上下文文本嵌入使我们能够利用现有预训练通用语言模型中的世界知识；为了支持这一假设，当通过 UMAP 绘制时，原子种族嵌入按其相关的地理区域松散地聚集在一起。对于被确定为多个种族的患者，我们取其原子嵌入的平均值。”. These contextual text embeddings allow us to take advantage of the world knowledge in existing pretrained general-purpose language models; in support of this hypothesis, when plotted via UMAP, the atomic ethnicity embeddings were loosely clustered by their associated geographic region. For patients who identified as multiple ethnicities, we took the mean of their atomic embeddings.

20

对于结构化数据，我们尽可能将每个领域锚定到标准临床术语：诊断以 ICD10 代码表示，药物映射到 RxNorm 成分标识符，并使用 LOINC 引用生命体征和实验室测试。数值测量（实验室测试、生命体征和流程图条目）首先与每个测试的通用单位一致，然后通过For structured data, we anchored each domain to standard clinical terminologies where possible: diagnoses were represented as ICD10 codes, medications were mapped to RxNorm ingredient identifiers, and vitals and laboratory tests were referenced using LOINC. Measurements with numeric values (laboratory tests, vital signs, and flowsheet entries) were first reconciled to a common unit per test, then transformed by标志sign ( x ) × 日志× log ( |x|+ 1) 稳定重尾。为了在保留序数结构的同时减少异常值的影响，我们将每个测试离散化为十个等宽（转换后）的箱，其中中央八个覆盖了经验 2+ 1) to stabilize heavy tails. To reduce the influence of outliers while retaining ordinal structure, we discretized each test into ten equal-width (post-transform) bins, where the central eight covered the empirical 2. 5 [第][th] –97 . 5 [第][th]百分位数，其余两个捕获极端下限和上限值。使用代理工作流程将分类值的测量规范化为紧凑的、特定于测试的答案集：一个大型语言模型为每个测试提出规范标签清单，第二个模型将自由文本响应（例如，“pos”、“positive”、“+”）映射到这些标签。标准化后，我们将结构化观察结果标记如下：每个 ICD 诊断和每个 RxNorm 成分都成为一个标记；每个数字测量值都由一个（代码，分位数箱）标记表示；以及每个分类测量（代码，规范类别）标记。这个过程产生了 235,768 个独特标记的结构化词汇，具有与大型语言模型类似的可学习嵌入。percentiles, and the remaining two captured extreme lower and upper values. Measurements with categorical values were canonicalized to a compact, test-specific answer set using an agentic workflow: one large language model proposed a canonical label inventory for each test and a second model mapped free-text responses (for example, “pos”, “positive”, “+”) to those labels. After normalization, we tokenized structured observations as follows: each ICD diagnosis and each RxNorm ingredient became a token; each numeric measurement was represented by a (code, quantile-bin) token; and each categorical measurement by a (code, canonical-category) token. This procedure yielded a structured vocabulary of 235,768 unique tokens with learnable embeddings similar as in large language models.

使用特定于模态的预训练编码器将非结构化数据压缩为固定维度嵌入。所有临床文本（包括进度注释、诊断报告和其他注释类型）都嵌入了预训练的临床语言模型（Gatortron-base [18]）。超过模型上下文窗口的音符被分割成连续的块并独立编码，然后对块嵌入进行平均以获得单个音符级表示。对于病理学和血液病理学，我们保留了报告和图像：全幻灯片图像使用 TITAN [43] 嵌入，血液学血涂片图像使用 DinoBloom [60] 嵌入；以及使用 CONCHv1.5 的电子显微镜和大体图像 [44]。对于非病理成像服务，我们使用随附的诊断报告（文本）而不是像素数据，从而提供跨专业的一致表示。Unstructured data were compressed to fixed-dimension embeddings using modality-specific pretrained encoders. All clinical text—including progress notes, diagnostic reports, and other note types were embedded with a pretrained clinical language model (Gatortron-base [18]). Notes exceeding the model’s context window were segmented into contiguous chunks and encoded independently, where chunk embeddings were then averaged to obtain a single note-level representation. For pathology and hematopathology, we retained both reports and images: whole-slide images were embedded with TITAN [43], hematology blood smear images with DinoBloom [60]; and electron microscopy and gross images with CONCHv1.5 [44]. For non-pathology imaging services, we used the accompanying diagnostic reports (text) rather than pixel data, providing a consistent representation across specialties.
