实施细节。Implementation details.我们在预训练期间使用的最大序列长度为 1,536 个事件。比这个短的序列用注意力掩码右填充，比这个长的序列通过对每步 1,536 个事件的连续窗口进行均匀采样来处理。优化使用带有梯度裁剪（最大范数 1.0）的 AdamW 和带有预热学习率计划的余弦。为了在多目标监督和异构令牌可用性下稳定优化，我们采用了两个学习速率组：共享编码器和嵌入参数的较低速率，以及特定模态投影仪和预测头的较高速率。这种选择减轻了罕见模式的高方差更新，同时允许小头快速适应。权重衰减应用于矩阵形参数，并排除偏差和 LayerNorm 权重。该模型的最大迭代次数为 30,000 次，每 1,000 次迭代对验证集进行验证。最终模型是根据最佳验证损失选择的。训练是在八个 NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU 上的分布式数据并行性下完成的。用于模型预训练的详细超参数可以在We used a maximum sequence length of 1,536 events during pretraining. Sequences shorter than this were right-padded with an attention mask, and sequences longer than this were handled by uniformly sampling a contiguous window of 1,536 events per step. Optimization used AdamW with gradient clipping (max norm 1.0) and a cosine with warmup learning rate schedule. To stabilize optimization under multi-objective supervision and heterogeneous token availability, we employed two learning-rate groups: a lower rate for the shared encoder and embedding parameters, and a higher rate for the modalityspecific projectors and prediction heads. This choice mitigates high-variance updates from rare modalities while allowing small heads to adapt rapidly. Weight decay was applied to matrix-shaped parameters, and biases and LayerNorm weights were excluded. The model was trained for a maximum iterations of 30,000, with validating on the validation set every 1,000 iterations. The final model was selected based on the best validation loss. Training was done under distributed data parallelism on eight NVIDIA A100-80GB GPUs. Detailed hyperparameters used for model pretraining can be found in扩展数据表5Extended Data Table 5 .

患者代表。Patient representation.除非另有说明，我们通过在推理时间附加诊断（即 ICD-10）、掩码标记并将其分配给患者上次就诊的时间编码，将患者的纵向记录总结为单个向量。增强序列通过编码器，并且该掩码 ICD 标记的上下文状态被视为患者嵌入。在操作上，这个“查询”标记要求模型预测患者当前的诊断概况，这是预训练期间使用的目标之一，从而鼓励嵌入聚合最能预测当前疾病负担的病史的那些方面。然后将该向量用作下游分析的患者代表。对于病史极长的患者，我们将原始序列限制为最近的 100,000 个事件。Unless otherwise specified, we summarize a patient’s longitudinal record as a single vector by appending a diagnosis, i.e., ICD-10, mask token at inference time and assigning it the time encoding of the patient’s last visit. The augmented sequence is passed through the encoder, and the contextual state of this masked ICD token is taken as the patient embedding. Operationally, this “query” token asks the model to predict the patient’s current diagnostic profile, which is one of the objectives used during pretraining, thereby encouraging the embedding to aggregate those aspects of the history most predictive of present disease burden. This vector is then used as the patient representation for downstream analyses. For patients with extremely long histories, we capped the raw sequence to the most recent 100,000 events.

评估框架Evaluation framework

我们对五个主要类别进行了事件发生时间 (TTE) 评估：新发疾病、疾病进展、治疗反应、不良事件和医院运营。我们在 95 项疾病发作任务上评估了 APOLLO（We conducted time-to-event (TTE) evaluations across five primary categories: new disease onset, disease progression, treatment response, adverse event, and hospital operations. We evaluated APOLLO on 95 disease onset tasks (扩展数据表6Extended Data Table 6），78 个疾病进展任务（), 78 disease progression tasks (扩展数据表8Extended Data Table 8), 59 项治疗反应任务 (), 59 treatment response tasks (扩展数据表10Extended Data Table 10），17 项不良事件任务（), 17 adverse event tasks (扩展数据表12Extended Data Table 12），以及12项医院运营任务（), and 12 hospital operations tasks (扩展数据表14Extended Data Table 14）。每个任务的元数据可以在相应的表中找到。). The metadata for each task can be found in the corresponding tables.

在 TTE 任务中，模型（在我们的例子中是固定的 APOLLO 患者嵌入和线性 Cox 头）接收所有患者特征作为输入，最多可达In TTE tasks, the model (in our case, fixed APOLLO patient embeddings and a linear Cox head) receives as input all patient features up to a快照时间snapshot time，旨在预测快照时间和预定时间之间的持续时间, and aims to predict the duration between the snapshot time and a predetermined终点endpoint。对于疾病发作任务，我们的目标是在诊断（终点）之前预测出院时（快照）特定疾病的风险。较高的风险对应于较短的诊断时间，较低的风险对应于较长的诊断时间。对于疾病进展任务，我们将快照设置为感兴趣疾病的诊断，并将终点设置为疾病进展的代理。这些替代指标可以包括诊断更严重的疾病变异、服用暗示更严重疾病的药物或死亡。对于治疗反应和不良事件任务，. For disease onset tasks, our objective was to predict the risk of a particular disease at the time of a hospital discharge (snapshot) prior to its diagnosis (endpoint). A higher risk corresponds to a shorter time to diagnosis, and a lower risk corresponds to a longer time to diagnosis. For disease progression tasks, we set the snapshot as the diagnosis of the disease of interest, and the endpoint is set to a proxy for disease progression. These proxies can include the diagnosis of a more severe disease variant, administration of a medication implying more severe disease, or death. For treatment response and adverse event tasks, the

23

快照是在第一次施用特定药物时拍摄的，并且终点被设置为治疗反应的代理，例如死亡或不良事件的发生。我们为这些任务选择 TTE 公式，因为它们受到右审查，当患者在其记录中的最后一个事件中未达到终点时就会发生右审查。审查受到终点风险（即，达到终点的低风险意味着审查的机会较高）以及不相关的混杂因素（例如，患者转移到另一家医院）的影响。snapshot is taken at time of first administration for a particular medication, and the endpoint is set to a proxy for treatment response, such as death or occurrence of an adverse event. We choose a TTE formulation for these tasks because they are subject to right-censorship, which occurs when a patient does not reach the endpoint as of the last event in their record. Censorship is influenced by both endpoint risk (i.e., low risk of reaching the endpoint means higher chance of censorship) as well as unrelated confounding factors (e.g., a patient moved to a different hospital).

为了评估模型性能，我们在预先指定的阈值持续时间内计算各种与时间相关的判别和校准指标To evaluate model performance, we compute a variety of time-dependent discrimination and calibration metrics at a pre-specified threshold duration ofτ ετ ∈R[+] 天 (R[+] days (扩展数据表 7-17Extended Data Tables 7-17）。为每个任务单独选择阈值持续时间，以反映在时间 0 施加的干预可能会改变时间点结果的时间间隔). The threshold duration is chosen individually for each task to reflect an interval in which an intervention applied at time 0 could plausibly change the outcome at timepointτ（以天为单位）。例如，心脏病等更多慢性疾病可能需要更长的时间(in days). For example, more chronic diseases such as heart disease may require a longerτ因为干预措施（例如生活方式的改变）可能需要很长时间才能体现为疾病风险的明显变化。另一方面，更急性的终点（例如，新冠肺炎死亡率）需要更小的since interventions (e.g., lifestyle changes) may take a long time to manifest as appreciable changes in disease risk. On the other hand, more acute endpoints (e.g., mortality from COVID) require smallerτ因为生物时间尺度更短。实际上，选择since biological timescales are shorter. Practically, the choice ofτ也由数据分布告知，以便通过时间积累足够的案例is also informed by the data distribution, such that sufficient cases are accumulated by timeτ为了使度量计算有效。有关每个指标的详细讨论，请参阅in order for metric calculations to be valid. For a detailed discussion of each metric, see指标和统计分析Metrics & statistical analysis .

在为每个任务的 MGB-7M 验证集构建评估分割时，从每个患者的医疗记录中提取所有有效快照和终点事件时间。然后，我们执行以下过滤步骤，以获得每个患者的单个快照端点对，以便每个患者在每个任务分割中只出现一次。对于疾病发作任务，最初选择前 5 次就诊后的所有出院情况作为有效快照，并选择疾病的首次诊断作为终点。为了增加终点的发生率并模拟现实世界的预测模型如何仅应用于高风险患者，我们仅将快照保留在目标疾病平均诊断年龄的两个标准差内。对于疾病进展任务，选择疾病的第一次诊断作为快照，并选择终点的第一次出现。对于治疗响应任务，选择第一次治疗作为快照。除非下面另有说明，否则我们保留所有任务端点的绝对第一次出现（请参阅When constructing the evaluation splits on the validation set of MGB-7M for each task, all valid snapshot and endpoint event times were extracted from each patient’s medical record. We then performed the following filtering steps to arrive at a single snapshot-endpoint pair for each patient, so that each patient is represented no more than once in each task split. For disease onset tasks, all hospital discharges after the first 5 visits are initially selected as valid snapshots and the first diagnosis of the disease was selected as the endpoint. To increase incidence of the endpoint and mimic how a real-world predictive model might be applied only to higher-risk patients, we kept only snapshots within two standard deviations of the mean age of diagnosis for the disease of interest. For disease progression tasks, the first diagnosis of the disease was selected as the snapshot and the first occurrence of the endpoint was selected. For treatment response tasks, the first administration of the treatment was selected as the snapshot. We kept the absolute first occurrence of the endpoint for all tasks unless otherwise specified below (see任务定义Task Definitions）。如果端点事件之前不存在有效的快照事件，我们将丢弃该患者。我们还丢弃了在快照事件发生 100 多年后才发生终点事件的患者。此外，为了过滤掉由于记录快照事件时潜在的管理延迟而导致快照和端点事件同时发生的实例，我们强制执行了一个中断期). We discarded the patient if no valid snapshot events existed prior to the endpoint event. We also discarded patients where the endpoint event occurred more than 100 years after the snapshot event. 我们为每个 TTE 任务训练了单独的 Cox 比例风险模型，以估计作为协变量函数的终点事件的风险。我们使用 APOLLO 提取患者级别的特征，其中输入包含患者医疗记录中截至快照时间的所有事件。对于结构化模式和最后进度说明基线（请参阅We trained separate Cox proportional hazards models for each TTE task to estimate the risk of the endpoint event as a function of covariates. The resulting linear predictorβ[⊤]xβ[⊤] x提供连续的风险评分，用于根据患者经历终点的相对风险对患者进行排名。我们使用生命线 0.30.0 中的 CoxPHFitter 实现，以及惩罚器provides a continuous risk score used to rank patients by their relative risk of experiencing the endpoint. 由于许多任务具有相对罕见的端点事件，因此我们采用案例队列抽样来提高计算效率并减轻训练数据中的极端审查。具体来说，我们构建了训练集中审查个体与非审查个体的最大比例为 4:1 的案例队列分割。这种重采样改变了训练集中的审查比率；然而，验证集和测试集保持不变，并保留原始的、自然的审查比率，以确保模型评估的公正性。由于用于系数估计的 Cox 偏似然对于基线风险是不变的，因此修改后的训练审查制度不会使学习到的风险分数产生偏差Because many tasks have relatively rare endpoint events, we employed case-cohort sampling to improve computational efficiency and mitigate extreme censorship in the training data. Specifically, we constructed casecohort splits with a maximum ratio of 4:1 censored to noncensored individuals in the training set. This resampling alters the censorship ratio in the training set; however, the validation and test sets are left unmodified and retain the original, natural censorship ratio to ensure unbiased model evaluation. Because the Cox partial likelihood used for coefficient estimation is invariant to the baseline hazard, the modified training censorship does not bias the learned risk scoresβ[⊤]xβ[⊤] x。然而，绝对生存概率估计确实取决于基线风险，因此在对测试集进行评估之前，使用 Breslow 估计器在未修改的验证集上重新估计了该函数。这个两步过程确保回归系数受益于训练期间丰富的案例表示，而生存概率估计反映了自然审查制度下的真实事件分布。. However, absolute survival probability estimates do depend on the baseline hazard, so this function was re-estimated on the unmodified validation set using the Breslow estimator prior to evaluation on the test set. This two-step procedure ensures that the regression coefficients benefit from the enriched case representation during training while the survival probability estimates reflect the true event distribution under the natural censoring regime.

基线Baselines

年龄-性别基线。Age–sex baseline.为了根据最小的人口统计预测变量来量化学习表征的价值，我们仅使用年龄和性别作为协变量构建了冻结的患者特征。年龄定义为输入序列中包含的最后一次就诊时患者的年龄（以天为单位）；性别被编码为带有虚拟指标的 3 级分类变量“男性”、“女性”、“未知”。该基线代表了仅依赖于人口统计数据的教科书风险评分中可用的信息。在 TTE 评估期间，该基线省略了 PCA。To quantify the value of learned representations against a minimal set of demographics predictors, we constructed frozen patient features using only age and sex as covariates. Age was defined as the patient’s age (in days) at the time of the last visit included in the input sequence; sex was encoded as a 3-level categorical variable Male, Female, Unknown with dummy indicators. This baseline represents the information available in textbook risk scores that rely solely on demographics. During TTE evaluation, PCA was omitted for this baseline.

25

结构化模式基线。Structured modalities baseline.为了更好地理解非结构化模式（注释和图像）对患者表征的贡献，我们通过仅使用结构化标记（诊断、药物、实验室、生命体征、流程图）以及与完整模型相同的预训练目标、标记器和编码器来训练 APOLLO 的变体，从而进行了消融研究。在推理时，患者表示仅根据结构化输入计算（使用与 APOLLO 相同的 ICD-10 掩码令牌提示）。得到的特征是 768 维的，与 APOLLO 相同。To better understand the contribution of unstructured modalities (notes and images) to a patient representation, we performed an ablation study by training a variant of APOLLO using only structured tokens (diagnoses, medications, labs, vitals, flowsheets) with the identical pretraining objective, tokenizer, and encoder as the full model. At inference, patient representations were computed from structured inputs only (using same ICD-10 mask-token prompt as for APOLLO). The resulting features are 768-dimensional, same as APOLLO.

最后的进展记录了基线。Last progress notes baseline.为了评估时间整合相对于单个纯文本快照的好处，我们通过在预测时间之前嵌入他们最近的进展记录（由 GatorTronbase [18]）来代表每个患者。生成的特征是 1024 维的。To assess the benefit of temporal integration relative to a single text-only snapshot, we represented each patient by the embedding of their most recent progress note (by GatorTronbase [18]) prior to the prediction time. The resulting features are 1024-dimensional.

监督基线。Supervised baseline.为了评估自监督预训练的价值，我们在没有预训练的情况下为每个任务端到端地训练了相同的 Transformer 架构。我们没有使用 APOLLO 用来形成患者嵌入的屏蔽 ICD 查询，而是使用 CLS 令牌并附加一个两层 MLP，该 MLP 随时间段输出离散危险。让To evaluate the value of self-supervised pretraining, we trained the same transformer architecture end-to-end for each task without pretraining. Instead of the masked ICD query used by APOLLO to form a patient embedding, we used the CLS token and attached a two-layer MLP that outputs discrete hazards over time bins. 我们在单个 GPU 上训练每个模型，批量大小为 128，学习率为 1e-5，并使用 AdamW 优化器进行优化。每个模型最多训练 40 个 epoch，如果在 5 个 epoch 内观察到验证损失没有改善，则提前停止验证集。We trained each model on a single GPU with batch size of 128, learning rate of 1e-5, optimized using AdamW optimizer. Each model was trained for a maximum 40 epochs, with early stopping on the validation set if no improvement on the validation loss was observed for 5 epochs.

检索Retrieval

检索任务设置如下：使用一组纳入标准定义队列，并使用 SQL 查询从 140 万患者的评估集中提取满足纳入标准的患者。The retrieval tasks are set up as follows: a cohort is defined using a set of inclusion criteria and patients satisfying the inclusion criteria are extracted from the evaluation set of 1.4M patients using SQL queries.

26

在单个日历时间（2025 年 1 月 1 日）提取所有患者的嵌入，以模仿当天所有患者的状态。截至该日期仍然活着的患者的医疗记录会被截断，以便仅在该日期之前的医疗事件包含在嵌入中。在该日期之前死亡的患者的病史中的所有事件都包含在嵌入中。对于每个任务，队列被分为五个相等的折叠，并且在每轮评估期间，从搜索索引中删除一个折叠（队列的 20%）以用作查询。检索指标是在此折叠上计算的，我们对其余 4 折叠重复该过程以获得平均值和标准差性能。对于文本和图像的多模态检索示例（Embeddings are extracted for all patients at a single calendar time (January 1st, 2025) to mimic the state of all patients on that day. Patients who are still alive as of that date have their medical records truncated such that only medical events prior to that date are included in the embedding. Patients who died prior to that date have all events in their medical history included in the embedding. For each task, the cohort is divided into five equal folds, and during each round of evaluation one fold (20% of the cohort) is removed from the search index to be used as the queries. Retrieval metrics are calculated on this fold, and we repeat the process with the remaining 4 folds to obtain mean and standard deviation performance. For the multimodal retrieval examples for text and image (图4c、dFigure 4c,d和and扩展数据 18Extended Data 18）检索结果，我们从整个评估集中检索。) retrieval results, we retrieve from the entire evaluation set.

对于每个任务，令牌按以下顺序排名For each task, tokens were ranked byA[́][¯]v按降序排列，生成人口级别的风险增加特征列表。结构化测量以建模期间使用的分辨率报告，即数字数据的（测试，bin）和分类条目的（测试，规范类别），而诊断和药物分别通过其 ICD-10 和 RxNorm 成分标识符报告。非结构化事件在管道中的处理方式相同。in descending order to produce a population-level list of riskincreasing features. Structured measurements are reported at the resolution used during modeling, i.e. (test, bin) for numeric data and (test, canonical category) for categorical entries, while diagnoses and medications are reported by their ICD-10 and RxNorm ingredient identifiers, respectively. Unstructured events were handled identically in the pipeline.

计算硬件和软件Computing hardware and software

我们使用Python（版本3.12.11）和PyTorch（版本2.6.0，CUDA 12.4）（https://pytorch.org/）进行研究中的所有实验和分析，可以使用如下开源库进行复制。对于模型预训练，我们使用了 8 个 GPU，配置为使用分布式数据并行 (DDP) 进行多 GPU 训练。我们的变压器还使用了 flash-attn（版本 2.7.4）和 ninja（版本 1.11.1.4）。We used Python (version 3.12.11) and PyTorch (version 2.6.0, CUDA 12.4) (https://pytorch.org/) for all experiments and analyses in the study, which can be replicated using open-source libraries as below. For model pretraining, we used 8 GPUs configured for multi-GPU training using distributed data-parallel (DDP). Our transformer additionally used flash-attn (version 2.7.4) and ninja (version 1.11.1.4).

我们在下游任务中使用了 Scikit-learn（版本 1.6.1）的 PCA、StandardScaler 和 Logistic Regression 实现。我们使用生命线库（版本 0.30.0）来实现生存任务中的 Cox 比例风险模型。 Matplotlib（版本 3.10.3）和 Seaborn（版本 0.13.2）用于创建绘图和图形。报告中详细介绍了其他各种 Python 库的使用We used implementations, specifically PCA, StandardScaler and Logistic Regression from Scikit-learn (version 1.6.1) in our downstream tasks. We used the lifelines library (version 0.30.0) for its implementation of the Cox proportional hazards model in survival tasks. Matplotlib (version 3.10.3) and Seaborn (version 0.13.2) were used to create plots and figures. Use of other miscellaneous Python libraries is detailed in the Reporting

29

总结。Summary.

数据可用性Data availability

根据机构政策，所有内部收集或整理的数据请求都将根据具体情况进行评估，以确定所请求的数据是否符合知识产权和患者隐私义务。数据只能出于学术研究目的而共享，并且需要材料转让协议。Following institution policies, all requests for data collected or curated in-house will be evaluated on a case-bycase basis to determine whether the data requested is compliant with intellectual property and patient privacy obligations. Data can only be shared for academic research purposes and will require a material transfer agreement.

代码可用性Code availability

APOLLO 预训练和评估流程的代码（包括风险预测和患者检索）将在发布后用于学术研究目的。Code for the APOLLO pretraining and evaluation pipeline, including risk prediction and patient retrieval, will be made available for academic research purposes upon publication.

扩展数据图Extended Data Figure 19: 其他本地和全局可解释性示例。 (一)Additional local and global interpretability examples. (a)本地分析。接受靶向治疗的 ROS1/ALK 改变的转移性肺腺癌患者的三年死亡风险轨迹。每个间隔中最大的贡献者对应于分期和再分期报告、胸部影像学、治疗反应评估、新的血栓栓塞事件（肺栓塞和深静脉血栓形成）以及疼痛评分、体重和疲劳等功能描述符。Local analysis. Three-year mortality risk trajectory for a patient with metastatic ROS1/ALK-altered lung adenocarcinoma receiving targeted therapy. The largest contributors in each interval correspond to staging and restaging reports, thoracic imaging, treatment-response assessments, new thromboembolic events (pulmonary embolism and deep-vein thrombosis), and functional descriptors such as pain score, weight and fatigue.(b-e)(b–e)全球分析。群体水平特征对另外四项下游任务（卵巢癌转移、蒽环类药物治疗心力衰竭后心肌病、主动脉瓣狭窄后生存以及阿哌沙班无中风/栓塞生存）的重要性通过积分梯度（IG）计算，如图 5 所示。对于卵巢癌转移（Global analysis. Population-level feature importance for four additional downstream tasks—ovarian cancer metastasis, cardiomyopathy after heart failure treated with anthracyclines, survival after aortic stenosis, and stroke/embolism-free survival with apixaban—computed via Integrated Gradients (IG) as in Fig. 5. For ovarian cancer metastasis (b），术后状态与手术和分期途径在晚期卵巢癌中的作用一致[65]。良性乳腺发育不良等与乳腺相关的术语似乎可以作为遗传性乳腺癌-卵巢癌易感性和下游监测/诊断级联的代表，而 BRCA1/2 相关的 HBOC 则导致卵巢癌和乳腺癌风险显着升高 [66]。尼古丁依赖还与粘液性卵巢癌的风险增加有关，并且与卵巢癌诊断后较差的生存率有关[67]。对于用蒽环类药物治疗心力衰竭后的心肌病（), postprocedural states are consistent with the role of surgical and staging pathways in advanced ovarian cancer [65]. Breast-related terms such as benign mammary dysplasia plausibly act as a proxy for hereditary breast–ovarian cancer susceptibility and the downstream surveillance/diagnostic cascade, and BRCA1/2-associated HBOC confers markedly elevated ovarian and breast cancer risk [66]. Nicotine dependence is additionally linked to increased risk of mucinous ovarian cancer and has been associated with worse survival after ovarian cancer diagnosis [67]. For cardiomyopathy after heart failure treated with anthracyclines (c），淋巴瘤和白血病术语的出现在临床上是一致的，因为这些诊断跟踪现实世界护理中的蒽环类药物暴露和治疗强度。蒽环类药物相关的左心室功能障碍受到累积剂量的强烈影响，并因患者水平的危险因素（例如年龄较大、既往存在的心血管疾病和心脏代谢合并症）而放大[68]。髓系白血病的具体表现与最近的心脏肿瘤学文献一致，该文献强调，接受含蒽环类药物治疗的老年 AML 人群心脏毒性风险较高[68]。主动脉瓣狭窄后的生存（), the emergence of lymphoma and leukemia terms is clinically coherent because these diagnoses track anthracycline exposure and treatment intensity in real-world care. Anthracycline-related LV dysfunction is strongly influenced by cumulative dose and is amplified by patient-level risk factors such as older age, pre-existing cardiovascular disease, and cardiometabolic comorbidities [68]. The specific appearance of myeloid leukemia aligns with recent cardio-oncology literature emphasizing that older AML populations treated with anthracycline-containing regimens have elevated cardiotoxicity risk [68]. For survival after aortic stenosis (d），首要归因集中于多种疾病，包括认知障碍和痴呆、感觉丧失、尿失禁、心力衰竭、静脉血栓栓塞、慢性肾病和并发感染[69]。 CKD 也是严重主动脉瓣狭窄和 TAVR 术后预后的一个公认的改善因素，随着肾脏疾病的进展，死亡率和并发症会更高。对于阿哌沙班治疗的无中风/栓塞生存期（), top attributors concentrate on multimorbidities including cognitive impairment and dementia, sensory loss, urinary incontinence, heart failure, venous thromboembolism, CKD, and intercurrent infection [69]. CKD is also a well-established modifier of prognosis in severe aortic stenosis and after TAVR, with higher mortality and complications as kidney disease advances. For apixaban-treated stroke/embolism-free survival (e），几个非常重要的特征，包括血压分层、肥胖/体重模式、痴呆症，反映了基线血栓栓塞风险和虚弱程度。良性前列腺增生（BPH）也似乎是首要危险因素，发现它与接触抗血栓药物的患者血尿相关并发症的发生率较高有关[70]。临床上，血尿并发症可导致抗凝治疗依从性降低或中止，其中与出血相关的中止和不坚持均与 AF 人群中风/全身性栓塞和死亡的较高风险相关[70]。为了保护患者隐私，图中显示的年龄与实际年龄随机移动 -2 至 2 岁，实验室测试和生命体征值以范围而不是确切数字的形式呈现。), several high-importance features including blood-pressure strata, obesity/weight patterns, dementia reflect baseline thromboembolic risk and frailty. Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) also appears as the top risk factor, which is found to be associated with higher rates of hematuria-related complications in patients exposed to antithrombotics [70]. Clinically, hematuria complications can drive reduced adherence or discontinuation of anticoagulation, where both bleeding-related discontinuation and non-persistence have been linked to higher risks of stroke/systemic embolism and death in AF populations [70]. To preserve patient privacy, ages shown in the figure are randomly shifted by -2 to 2 years from their actual age, and lab test and vitals values are presented as ranges instead of exact numbers.

扩展数据表Extended Data Table 8: 疾病进展预测任务的定义。Definition of disease progression prediction tasks.我们评估了 78 项疾病进展任务中的 TTE 表现。We evaluated TTE performance on 78 disease progression tasks.τ是阈值持续时间。发生率是指测试集中达到指定终点的患者的百分比is the threshold duration. Incidence refers to the percentage of patients in the test set who reach the endpoint by the specifiedτ。快照事件和终点事件列指定用于识别任务列中指示的疾病的所有 ICD-10 代码。对于某些任务，其中终点事件是药物的管理，我们提供用于识别终点的药物名称列表。. The Snapshot Event and Endpoint Event columns specify all ICD-10 codes used to identify the disease indicated in the Task column. For some tasks, where the Endpoint Event is the administration of a medication, we provide the list of medication names used to identify the endpoint.

扩展数据表Extended Data Table 14: 医院运营预测任务的定义。Definition of hospital operations prediction tasks.我们评估了 12 项医院运营任务中的 TTE 表现。直到快照事件为止，患者历史记录都会提供给模型。该模型预测终点事件（入院、出院或疾病诊断）是否会在以下所示的持续时间内发生：We evaluated TTE performance on 12 hospital operations tasks. The patient history is given to the model up to the snapshot event. The model predicts whether the endpoint event (hospital admission, discharge, or disease diagnosis) will occur within the duration indicated byτ。发生率是指测试集中达到指定终点的患者的百分比. Incidence refers to the percentage of patients in the test set who reach the endpoint by the specifiedτ。对于触发事件为入院的任务，我们将快照时间设置为入院后24小时，以积累预测特征。例如，在急性脓毒症任务中，模型会获得 ED 到达后 24 小时内的所有数据，并预测患者在接下来的 6 天内（入院后 1 周）是否会被诊断为脓毒症。. For tasks where the trigger event is a hospital admission, we set the snapshot time to 24 hours after admission to accumulate predictive features. For example, in the Acute Sepsis task, the model is given all data up to 24 hours after ED arrival and predicts whether the patient will be diagnosed with sepsis within the next 6 days (1 week after admission).

扩展数据表Extended Data Table 16: 检索队列的定义。Definition of retrieval cohorts.我们评估了 61 个队列的检索性能。每个队列由诊断患有指定疾病（ICD-10 代码）并随后开出指定疗法（成分 RxCUI 或药物名称）的患者定义。队列大小表示每个队列中的患者数量。We evaluated retrieval performance on 61 cohorts. Each cohort is defined by patients diagnosed with the indicated disease (ICD-10 codes) and later prescribed the indicated therapy (ingredient RxCUIs or drug names). Cohort Size indicates the number of patients in each cohort.P是队列规模除以评估集的总规模（140 万患者）。is the cohort size divided by the total size of the evaluation set (1.4M patients).
